text:
Hi Everyone 🤍,
I really need help right now and I don’t know where else to turn.

My girlfriend and I are being forced to leave the hostel we’ve been staying at and working for, effective immediately. We were just transferred to Van Nuys a few days ago with everything we own, and now we’re being told it’s “not a good fit” and that all locations are suddenly full. We weren’t given a real reason, just told to go.

We are literally about to be put out with all of our belongings in our hands and nowhere to go. No plan. No destination. Just… out.

I have been through homelessness before, and I am genuinely terrified of going through that again. It’s not just “finding somewhere to sleep.” It’s losing everything you own piece by piece, carrying your life around, not knowing where you’re safe, and constantly being turned away when you ask for help.

I have spent hours trying to find resources. I’ve gone in person to places that were listed as “available” just to find out they don’t even exist anymore. I called 211 hoping for real help, and all I got were outdated lists sent to my email that led to dead ends. I wasted an entire day chasing help that wasn’t actually there. It feels impossible and honestly unreal.

At this point, I’m not asking for anything big — I just need something immediate. A safe place for us to land, even temporarily. A couch, a room, anything to keep us from being on the street with everything we own.

We are clean, respectful, and actively trying to get back on our feet. We just need a chance to not fall all the way down right now.

If anyone can help, knows someone, or has any real leads, please message me. I am truly scared and running out of time.

Even if you can’t help directly, please consider sharing this. I’m trying to reach as many people as possible before we’re out with nowhere to go. It would mean more than you know🫶🏼

Thank you for reading 🤍

with a slight red tone left in the skin.

The shape itself was still good —
it fit her face.

And the pigment wasn’t too dense,
which gave us space to work with it, not against it.

So instead of removing —
we corrected it.

Softly. Carefully.
Bringing everything back to a clean, natural baseline.

This result was achieved in one session.
Not every old PMU can be covered.
But when it’s done right —
you don’t need to start from zero.

If you’re not sure about your case —
send me @olesia.sharun.pmu a photo of your brows without makeup.

Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space. 

About the rooms:
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

🛏️ Larger bedroom — $1,620/month (Utilities not included)
🛏️ Smaller bedroom — $1,280/month (Utilities not included)🚿 Shared bathroom (between the 2 rooms only)

🍳 Fully stocked kitchen

❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator
🚗 Parking included — backlot

📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA 

About me:
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

What I'm looking for:
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup.

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

Hi! My name is Ashley, and I’m currently living in Hollywood but looking to relocate closer to Culver City for work.

I work in-office Monday through Thursday and have Fridays as a work-from-home day. I value a quiet, clean, and peaceful living environment and am very respectful of shared spaces.

I’m turning 30 next month and am ideally looking for a place of my own (studio or 1 bed/1 bath). I’ve had past roommate experiences and am now prioritizing a more independent living situation. That said, I’m open to situations where others have a similar work schedule or are not home often.

A bit about me:
• Clean, responsible, and low-key  
• No pets  
• Don’t party—occasionally enjoy a happy hour or weekend event  
• In a relationship, but any visits/overnights would always be communicated and respectful  

My ideal budget is around $1,600, and I’m looking for a long-term rental.

If you have something that might be a good fit or know of anything available, I’d love to connect. Thank you!

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a short or long-term roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! No pets allowed, unfortunately. The apartment is conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance. 

Common areas are fully furnished! The space is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas. I love animals, but no pets allowed unfortunately! 

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month beginning July 1st (if you decide to stay longer). There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

Hey friends! I’m looking for a fun, clean, young professional to **sublet the master bedroom** in my dreamy Silver Lake townhome. ✨

MUST BE LGBTQ+ Friendly and preferably female/femme.

This is a **2 bed / 2 bath multi-level home**, and you’d be renting the **primary (master) bedroom + your own private ensuite bathroom** in a shared space. The primary bedroom is in its own floor (second floor) so lots of privacy!

text:
Hi everyone! Looking for a roommate for our 3 bed 2.5 bath house in Glassell Park!

As my partner and I share a room for an office, we have an open room available! We don’t have a preference in which room would be our office so wanted to let the potential roommate decide!

You would have your own private bathroom and access to our deck that has a projector, fireplace and tiki bar! 

Rent: 6 month sublease. $1,700/ a month with all utilities/ internet included.

Room 1 (pictured with the sofa) Has a large closet with mirrors and a window that over looks the back space with a pretty tree. This would be the more private option.

Room 2 (pictured with the shelves) Does not have a closet but it does include nice built in shelving. It is linked to the shared deck so the potential roommate would have to be okay giving access through the room for that space. 

The private bathroom is accessible through the hallway and has a new filtered shower head and a bathtub. 

The neighborhood: The street is very quiet and is a 10 minute walk to Glassell Park that has big open fields, soccer fields, tennis courts, baseball fields and a pool. The area is so lovely to walk around with amazing views. We live about a 5 minute drive from highland park and eagle rock and then a 10 minute drive to Echo Park/ Silverlake.

Parking: There is always ample street parking and you’ll never have trouble finding a spot that is steps to the front door. 

About Us: We are a newly engaged couple who are both creatives and work full time and often from home. My partner is in music so the potential roommate would have to be okay with the occasional loud music but at reasonable hours. 

We would prefer someone who is 25-35 and unfortunately no pets as we have two! One is a big sheepadoodle who loves big hugs and another who is a small schnauzer and everyone’s favorite lap dog. Open to any gender or however you may identify ❤️

*** Note- Candidates will be subject to to a third party credit check with proof on income and renters insurance ****

Looking forward to hearing from you!

Private room available in 2-bedroom, 1 bathroom 2-story 1920's Spanish style courtyard townhouse in quiet residential East Hollywood neighborhood.

**Move-in date: May 1 (flexible)**

 

Month to month, **$1380/month plus $85 utilities** (incl. water/power/gas/gardener, high speed Wi-Fi and residential street parking permit). Optional: Personal gated carport parking space. One month security deposit required (may be paid in 2 installments).

 

Couples will be considered. Sorry, currently no dogs.

 

Room is light & airy, unfurnished (I can provide a work desk and chair), and has a great courtyard view with a loquat tree in front of window, and a spacious walk-in closet. Shared bathroom with both shower and dub, washer and dryer on premises, hardwood floors. You are welcome to use the household items and appliances I already have here.

 

Very spacious community courtyard with patio heater and BBQs and lots of gardening opportunities. Neighbors are chill and mostly creative professionals.

 

You would share the house with me (female European transplant) and two cats (they are mostly outdoor cats). 

I am a singer/songwriter and my IG is @myviolence_music.

text:
Heyooo, we're an early to mid 30's queer and disability friendly household looking for a 3rd come May 1st. **Master bedroom with ensuite bathroom + parking spot** for $1,300 available in a 3B/3B townhouse in Midcity - 90016.** Available May 1st. **

Please Fill out this Google form if you feel like this space is a good fit for you: 

[https://forms.gle/6XRtT6SvfSbZP2Yk6](https://forms.gle/6XRtT6SvfSbZP2Yk6)

**MOVE IN ----------------------------**
• North Facing Room: **May 1st 2026**

• MONTHLY RENT: **$1300 ** (+Utilities ~$125/month)

• SECURITY DEPOSIT: **$1200**

• CREDIT REQUIREMENTS: **700+** only

• PROOF OF INCOME REQUIRED 50k+ (Or Strong Co-signer)

• Unfurnished Private Room + Private Bathroom

• 1500 square feet townhouse

• **NO PETS (allergies) & NO COUPLES**

**The Space ----------------------------** 

We generally socialize outside of the apartment and prefer home to be a restful space. Space has great natural light throughout all times of the day and is a sun-drenched space great for all potential plant daddies :) We invite you to help redecorate the space and create a sense of home! Your roommates are early to mid 30’s professionals from NYC and Orange County. We enjoy coming home to a restful space and occasionally have friends over for small get-togethers but overall, prefer a low-key space.  Everyone has their own private bathroom. Street parking is not too hard in our area, generally found at the beginning of the block. Grocery stores, gyms, and restaurants are close by. Unfortunately, no pets due to allergies.

**You ----------------------------** 

A working professional in the 28-40 age range who is community oriented, conscientious about their living space and tidy in common areas. Ideally someone who also wants their home space to be a restful and respectful environment. We greatly appreciate folx who can communicate directly about their needs and preferences. An accountable person who can be mindful towards everyone’s needs. Our home is our sanctuary and we hope you would want to treat this space with respect as well :) 

**Roommates** **----------------------------** 

**• Lola (34 - They/Them) AFAB | **IG : @Lola_718_

Moved to LA 5 years ago and originally from Queens, NYC. I grew up in an enclave of cultural eclecticism and LA seemed like the next place to make home with better weather and climbing all year round.  I’m an introspective person and enjoy philosophy. I’m an adaptive rock climber, foodie, hiker and general outdoor enthusiast.  I live with a disability and am in different states of recovery.  I have a 9-5 schedule 3 days of the week and am usually up by 7 am.  I have a background of serial entrepreneurship and investing.  

**• Minh - 29.75 (He/Him/They/Them) | **IG: @minhquannn_

Originally from OC, recent LA resident. Friendly and chill guy here. I am an AMC a-lister, always down for an art gallery trip, trying new food, and traveling. I work remotely but when I'm not working, I'm usually out and about (not much of a homebody). I visit OC once/week for tennis and visit family. I meal prep on weekdays but eat out on weekends. Always looking for new friends or tennis buddies. The world is crazy enough, let’s be decent people to one another, yeah? ;)

**Amenities** **----------------------------** 

• Central heating and AC

• In-unit washer and dryer

• Full Gas stove/oven (Great for cooks) 

• Dishwasher/garbage disposal

• Filtered water and ice dispenser

• Private bathroom 

• Street parking is not hard on our street 

**House Rules** **----------------------------**

• Common space monthly cleaning included in rent

• Clean up after yourself in common spaces and kitchen after cooking

• Delegation of household chores like taking out trash 

• Quiet hours after 11pm

• Both roommates are morning folx who are 9-5’ers 

• **Guest Policy: **Guests are okay, give each other a heads up, visitors generally 7 day soft limit 

• Shoes off, please 

• Roommate meetings last Sunday of every month to address things that arise 

• We ask you give 60 days notice and find a replacement before moving out

Please Fill out this google form if you feel like this space is a good fit for you, and we'll contact you. 

[https://forms.gle/6XRtT6SvfSbZP2Yk6](https://forms.gle/6XRtT6SvfSbZP2Yk6)

🏡 Looking for 2 Roommates – Room 1 ($1280) Room 2 ($1620) | Near USC
Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space.

**About the rooms:**
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

🛏️ Larger bedroom — **$1,620/month (Utilities not included)**
🛏️ Smaller bedroom — **$1,280/month (Utilities not included)**

❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator
🚗 Parking included — backlot
⚡ EV charger — compatible with all vehicles
📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**About me:**
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea.
 

**The location:**
Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for:**
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup. 

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

Looking for 2 Roommates – Rooms from $1,280/mo | Near USC
Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space.

**About the rooms:**
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

 Larger bedroom — **$1,620/month (Utilities not included)**
 Smaller bedroom — **$1,280/month (Utilities not included)**
 Shared bathroom (between the 2 rooms only)
 Fully furnished living room  Full dining room setup
 Fully stocked kitchen
 Professional cleaners provided — on me, not you
 Brand new Samsung washer & dryer — IN UNIT
 Brand new Samsung refrigerator
 Parking included — backlot
 EV charger — compatible with all vehicles
 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**About me:**
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea.

**The location:**
Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for:**
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup.

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

Subletting Bedroom in a 3B/2B Apartment in Palms (Available May/June)

Hey everyone! We’re looking for someone to take over my room in our spacious 3 bed / 2 bath apartment in Palms/Culver City, available starting May/June. Perfect for UCLA students or staff — only a 15-minute drive to campus and close to public transit (R12 stop just a 5-minute walk, R6/Culver 6 stop 10 minutes).

The Space:
 ∙ Rent: $960/month (includes a large bedroom and tandem parking spot)
 ∙ WiFi: $23.75/month
       ∙    Utilities: Under $50/month (water, sewage, trash)
 ∙ Laundry: On-site (coin + app operated)

It’s been a great home and I’d love to leave it in good hands!

If you’re interested, send me a message with a little bit about yourself and a good time to meet!

text:
🏡 Looking for 2 Roommates – Rooms from $1,280/mo | Near USC
Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space.

**About the rooms: **
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

🛏️ Larger bedroom — **$1,620/month (Utilities not included)**
🛏️ Smaller bedroom — **$1,280/month (Utilities not included)**
🚿 Shared bathroom (between the 2 rooms only) 
🛋️ Fully furnished living room 🍽️ Full dining room setup 
🍳 Fully stocked kitchen 
🧹 Professional cleaners provided — on me, not you 
🫧 Brand new Samsung washer & dryer — IN UNIT
❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator 
🚗 Parking included — backlot 
⚡ EV charger — compatible with all vehicles 
📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**About me:**
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea.
 

**The location:** 
Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for: **
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup. 

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

AMAZING ROOM & ADU FOR RENT IN AN AWESOME HOUSE, PRIME LOCATION! 

Hey there! We’re looking for female-identifying or gender non-conforming roommates to fill two of the amazing living spaces (each with a private bathroom) in our new rental home in super cute/walkable Los Feliz, starting MAY 1! More details below, please message if interested! :) 

A little about the rental spaces…There are two separate living areas available for rent (see pictures of each below!):
1. A spacious, stand-alone ADU with tons of storage and it’s very own bathroom (tub + shower), kitchen (oven, stove, fridge, etc), washer/dryer (separate from the ones in the main house), and mini-split A/C unit! We are asking $2500/month, plus utilities (split evenly), for this HUGE unfurnished space (which includes full access to/use of the main house and backyard).
2. A private, unfurnished bedroom on the second floor of the main house with its own bathroom (tub + shower) and closet for storage! The space gets great natural light, with easy access to the in-unit washer/dryer, multiple LARGE communal living spaces, and the gorgeous backyard/patio. For this deluxe room, we are asking $1850/month, plus utilities (split evenly). 

A little about the house…It’s located in a quiet-yet-central pocket of Los Feliz, walkable to SO many places – cafes/coffee shops, the grocery store, Los Feliz 3 movie theater, Los Feliz Flea Market, etc. The house is so CHARMING, with arched entryways and an old-Hollywood vibe. It has a SPACIOUS KITCHEN with an island (great for cooking!), a designated DINING ROOM (with three skylights), MULTIPLE COMMON LIVING AREAS (including a cozy window nook), and an AWESOME BACKYARD & PATIO lined with plants. Other amenities include AC/CENTRAL HEATING and IN-UNIT WASHER DRYER.  There is a driveway for parking (shared amongst all tenants), as well as ample street parking (no permits required). Utility costs are divided evenly between all tenants. The house will be mostly furnished, though individual living spaces (including the two spaces available for rent) will come unfurnished. 

A little about us…We are three women in our 20s, all LMU grads who are now working in film/entertainment-related fields. We’re all very clean, respectful, and easy-going. Additionally, we have 2 adorable small/mid-size doggos (Copper & Penny 🐶🙂).

text:
Hi! My roommate is moving, and I’m looking for someone to sublease her unfurnished room in a 2-bed, 1-bath apartment in the heart of West Hollywood! This is an incredible location off Fairfax and Santa Monica Blvd. It’s an incredibly safe, walkable area, and you’ll be steps away from the WeHo Farmers Market, The Grove, Whole Foods, Target, the Melrose Trading Post, and all the best bars, restaurants, and shops on Santa Monica Blvd. It is such an awesome apartment!
The Details:
• Rent: $1,440/month + utilities (~$100)
• Parking: Closed garage parking included! 🤩
• Availability: Looking for someone to move in May 1st. Currently month-to-month, but we can start a new long-term lease together if you'd prefer. I’ll prioritize candidates who will stay long term. 
• Amenities: On-site washer/dryer, dishwasher, and a kitchen with stainless steel appliances.
• The Space: Massive living room, bedroom, and closet with great natural lighting and full-length mirrors.
• Outdoor Space: Private patio/balcony (the unit is technically on the second floor, but sits three stories up).
About the Household:
You will be living with me and my two sweet cats 🙂
• Me: I’m in my early 30s and a PhD student. I’m clean, tidy, and generally social, though I definitely value my alone time as well. Every once in a while I’ll have a friend or two over, but I’m not into loud partying at home.
• The Cats: They are both social, though one is a bit more outgoing than the other. They are both so sweet! I really love and care for them, so if you’re a cat person, that’s a huge plus!
What I’m Looking For:
• Communication: Someone who values open and easy communication.
• Boundaries: Respect for each other’s space and privacy.
• Cleanliness: I’m not a total clean-freak, but I really appreciate someone who cleans up after themselves and keeps the common spaces tidy.

Girls only, and no more pets unfortunately.

Looking forward to hearing from you! 🙂

Looking for a female roommate in her 20s–30s who is clean, considerate, and a good fit for a shared space.

🏡 Looking for 2 Roommates – Room 1 ($1280) Room 2 ($1620) | Near USC
Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space.

**About the rooms:**
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

🛏️ Larger bedroom — **$1,620/month (Utilities not included)**
🛏️ Smaller bedroom — **$1,280/month (Utilities not included)**

🍳 Fully stocked kitchen

❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator
🚗 Parking included — backlot
⚡ EV charger — compatible with all vehicles
📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**About me:**
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea.
 

**The location:**
Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for:**
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup. 

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a short or long-term roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! No pets allowed, unfortunately. The apartment is conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance. 

Common areas are fully furnished! The space is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas. I love animals, but no pets allowed unfortunately! 

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month beginning July 1st (if you decide to stay longer). There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

groupTitle: LOS ANGELES ROOMS FOR RENT

text:
AMAZING ROOM & ADU FOR RENT IN AN AWESOME HOUSE, PRIME LOCATION! 

Hey there! We’re looking for female-identifying or gender non-conforming roommates to fill two of the amazing living spaces (each with a private bathroom) in our new rental home in super cute/walkable Los Feliz, starting MAY 1! More details below, please message if interested! :) 

A little about the rental spaces…There are two separate living areas available for rent (see pictures of each below!):
1. A spacious, stand-alone ADU with tons of storage and it’s very own bathroom (tub + shower), kitchen (oven, stove, fridge, etc), washer/dryer (separate from the ones in the main house), and mini-split A/C unit! We are asking $2500/month, plus utilities (split evenly), for this HUGE unfurnished space (which includes full access to/use of the main house and backyard).
2. A private, unfurnished bedroom on the second floor of the main house with its own bathroom (tub + shower) and closet for storage! The space gets great natural light, with easy access to the in-unit washer/dryer, multiple LARGE communal living spaces, and the gorgeous backyard/patio. For this deluxe room, we are asking $1850/month, plus utilities (split evenly). 

A little about the house…It’s located in a quiet-yet-central pocket of Los Feliz, walkable to SO many places – cafes/coffee shops, the grocery store, Los Feliz 3 movie theater, Los Feliz Flea Market, etc. The house is so CHARMING, with arched entryways and an old-Hollywood vibe. It has a SPACIOUS KITCHEN with an island (great for cooking!), a designated DINING ROOM (with three skylights), MULTIPLE COMMON LIVING AREAS (including a cozy window nook), and an AWESOME BACKYARD & PATIO lined with plants. Other amenities include AC/CENTRAL HEATING and IN-UNIT WASHER DRYER.  There is a driveway for parking (shared amongst all tenants), as well as ample street parking (no permits required). Utility costs are divided evenly between all tenants. The house will be mostly furnished, though individual living spaces (including the two spaces available for rent) will come unfurnished. 

A little about us…We are three women in our 20s, all LMU grads who are now working in film/entertainment-related fields. We’re all very clean, respectful, and easy-going. Additionally, we have 2 adorable small/mid-size doggos (Copper & Penny 🐶🙂).

text:
JUST LISTED TEMECULA 

Beautiful upgraded home located in the highly desirable gated community of The Fairways at Redhawk in South Temecula. 33413 Alagon St, Temecula, CA. This spacious two-story residence offers approximately 2,478 sq ft of living space with 4 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, perfectly designed for comfortable family living.

The home features numerous interior upgrades including granite kitchen countertops and laminate wood flooring throughout, giving the property a modern and elegant feel. The spacious kitchen with center island opens to a large family room with a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect space for gatherings and entertaining.

Downstairs you will find a formal living room, open family room, upgraded kitchen, and a convenient guest half bath. Upstairs features four bedrooms, two full  bathrooms, and an indoor laundry room for added convenience.

Situated on a desirable corner lot with a private backyard and direct-access two-car garage, this home offers great curb appeal and functionality. Located in South Temecula near top-rated Temecula schools, parks, and golf courses. Just minutes from Pechanga Resort & Casino, Old Town Temecula, Temecula Valley Hospital, and popular shopping centers including Vail Ranch Headquarters, Temecula Promenade Mall, and numerous grocery stores, restaurants, and cafes. Enjoy the lifestyle Temecula is famous for with nearby Temecula Valley wineries, scenic hot air balloon rides over wine country, hiking trails, and outdoor recreation. Convenient access to the I-15 freeway makes commuting easy while still enjoying the charm and attractions that make Temecula one of Southern California’s most desirable places to live.

Cesar Khandjian

PHA Realty Group

text:
Hi! I’m looking for someone to rent a Private Bedroom in a Safe Gated Community starting May 1st. Rent is $1300

It’s a spot in a 4-bedroom fully furnished, newly built house in a safe neighbourhood. 

Location: 

Located at the intersection of Torrance, Palos Verdes, and San Pedro; this location is a perfect 20 minute distance from LAX, Redondo Beach, Hermosa Beach, and Long Beach. 

About You: 

I’m seeking a responsible female tenant and values a clean living space. This home is perfect for professionals, students, or anyone looking for a peaceful, fun, and secure place to live. 

Key Features:

Spacious Private Bedroom and shared bathroom 
4-Bedroom Newly Built, Fully Furnished Home 
Free Parking Spot Space 
Shared Kitchen and Living Areas
High-Speed Internet
In-house Laundry Facilities
Access to Community Amenities - Pool, Spa, Fire-Pit, Fitness Center, Dog Park

text:
Room for rent in Culver City in a detached house, available in a week!
We are looking for a roommate to move in our 3rd bedroom in a shared 3br, 2 ba detached house in Culver City (studio village area) with the possibility of getting on the lease after a trial period. Available starting April 10th!

Rent: $1550/month excluding utilities. Utilities are usually $100-150/person for water, electric, gas, internet and gardener. 

About us: We are two females in our 30's, full time working professionals in film/photo industry and I am doing school part time, hopefully going back full time by fall. We love art, movies, music, staying active (tennis, surfing, rock climbing). We are looking for someone who is also a full time professional and/or student with proven income, ideally with similar schedule. 

Our back yard and patio is the highlight of the home, featuring gas and charcoal grills, picnic bench, and gas table with fire in the covered patio area.  We don't have pets and would prefer to keep it pet free. A bit about the room and the house:

- Available April 10th, looking to find someone asap! 
- It comes furnished with all the furniture you see in the photos but I am open to moving out things if needed. Furniture included: Queen bed + mattress, large desk, desk chair, some shelves, closet. 
- The bathroom is shared with my room on the other side of it. My other roommate has her own bathroom which also typically serves as the guest bathroom. 
- The house has a living room, dining room, kitchen, washer and dryer, detached garage that fits 1 car. 
- Street parking is ample and free with street cleanings happening twice a week
- Area is super quiet and family friendly. We are not a party house, are organized, and clean, pretty quiet and busy with work and life. 

Please DM me if interested and we can do a video call + tour or you can check out the room in person in in the area. :)

Subletting Bedroom in a 3B/2B Apartment in Palms (Available May/June)

Hey everyone! We’re looking for someone to take over my room in our spacious 3 bed / 2 bath apartment in Palms/Culver City, available starting May/June. Perfect for UCLA students or staff — only a 15-minute drive to campus and close to public transit (R12 stop just a 5-minute walk, R6/Culver 6 stop 10 minutes).

The Space:
 ∙ Rent: $960/month (includes a large bedroom and tandem parking spot)
 ∙ WiFi: $23.75/month
       ∙    Utilities: Under $50/month (water, sewage, trash)
 ∙ Laundry: On-site (coin + app operated)
 ∙ Kitchen: Fully equipped, with a recently upgraded fridge and dishwasher
 ∙ Storage: Tons of closet and cabinet space

Location Perks:
 ∙ Walking distance to Ralphs, LA Fitness, and lots of restaurants in downtown Culver
 ∙ Quiet neighborhood with easy access to the 405 and 10 freeways

A few notes:
 ∙ No pets (sorry!)
 ∙ $1,000 security deposit
 ∙ Flexible arrangement (sublease or lease transfer depending on landlord approval — details TBD)

About us:
You’ll be living with two awesome, easygoing roommates: a guy and a girl, both working professionals in their mid-20s. They’re respectful, clean, and genuinely easy to live with. You couldn’t ask for better people to share a space with. I’m heading off to grad school and need to pass this place on to someone who’ll appreciate it as much as I have. It’s been a great home and I’d love to leave it in good hands!

If you’re interested, send me a message with a little bit about yourself and a good time to meet!

text:
AMAZING ROOM & ADU FOR RENT IN AN AWESOME HOUSE, PRIME LOCATION! 

Hey there! We’re looking for female-identifying or gender non-conforming roommates to fill two of the amazing living spaces (each with a private bathroom) in our new rental home in super cute/walkable Los Feliz, starting MAY 1! More details below, please message if interested! :) 

A little about the rental spaces…There are two separate living areas available for rent (see pictures of each below!):
1. A spacious, stand-alone ADU with tons of storage and it’s very own bathroom (tub + shower), kitchen (oven, stove, fridge, etc), washer/dryer (separate from the ones in the main house), and mini-split A/C unit! We are asking $2500/month, plus utilities (split evenly), for this HUGE unfurnished space (which includes full access to/use of the main house and backyard).
2. A private, unfurnished bedroom on the second floor of the main house with its own bathroom (tub + shower) and closet for storage! The space gets great natural light, with easy access to the in-unit washer/dryer, multiple LARGE communal living spaces, and the gorgeous backyard/patio. For this deluxe room, we are asking $1850/month, plus utilities (split evenly). 

A little about the house…It’s located in a quiet-yet-central pocket of Los Feliz, walkable to SO many places – cafes/coffee shops, the grocery store, Los Feliz 3 movie theater, Los Feliz Flea Market, etc. The house is so CHARMING, with arched entryways and an old-Hollywood vibe. It has a SPACIOUS KITCHEN with an island (great for cooking!), a designated DINING ROOM (with three skylights), MULTIPLE COMMON LIVING AREAS (including a cozy window nook), and an AWESOME BACKYARD & PATIO lined with plants. Other amenities include AC/CENTRAL HEATING and IN-UNIT WASHER DRYER.  There is a driveway for parking (shared amongst all tenants), as well as ample street parking (no permits required). Utility costs are divided evenly between all tenants. The house will be mostly furnished, though individual living spaces (including the two spaces available for rent) will come unfurnished. 

A little about us…We are three women in our 20s, all LMU grads who are now working in film/entertainment-related fields. We’re all very clean, respectful, and easy-going. Additionally, we have 2 adorable small/mid-size doggos (Copper & Penny 🐶🙂).

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a short or long-term roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! No pets allowed, unfortunately. The apartment is conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance. 

Common areas are fully furnished! The space is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas. I love animals, but no pets allowed unfortunately! 

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month beginning July 1st (if you decide to stay longer). There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a FaceTime or in-person tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

Room Available – 2 Bed / 2 Bath (KTown / East Hollywood) – Parking Included
Looking for someone to take over a room in a 2 bed / 2 bath in a super central part of LA—right between Koreatown and East Hollywood.

⸻

 • Your own private bedroom

 • Second bathroom is basically yours (I’ve got the en suite)

 • Gated parking included (rare out here)

⸻

The apartment

This has been one of those spots that just works:

 • ~10 min walk to the Red Line (Beverly/Vermont)

 • Easy access to KTown, East Hollywood, Silver Lake

 • Quiet building (families + long-term tenants)

 • Pool + laundry in building

 • Management is responsive and easy to deal with

Super central, but still feels calm when you’re home.

⸻

About me

Hey, I’m Tayo.

I’m a freelance cinematographer and have been in LA about 6 years—4 of those in this apartment. It’s been a really solid home base.

I’m laid-back, respectful, and big on communication. I’ve also had the same roomate since I’ve been here who was here 2 years before I was (how we’ve kept rent so cheap) he’s only having to leave because of unexpected health issues and I wanted to help him find a replacement (someone that can start the process with management next week) asap so he can focus on his next steps/ healing.

⸻

Costs

 • Rent: $1,111

 • Utilities: ~$150–$200

 • Internet: ~$50

 • Deposit: $1,000 (to outgoing roommate)

For the location, parking, and basically having your own bathroom, it’s honestly a great deal.

⸻

Whether you’re social or more to yourself, both work excited to chat and thank you if you took the time to read all of that lol also management wants 650 credit score some sort of proff of income (bank statements are fine)

text:
Fully furnished private bedroom and full bath for rent! I need someone to take over my lease (ends 7/11). Move in day is flexible, preferably May 1st. You can also renew for the next school year.

Room: Large bedroom with amazing natural lighting, large walk in closet, a long hallway leading to the large bathroom with plenty of storage space

Rent: $1,709 NOT including utilities 

Location: across the street from USC health science campus and Keck hospital, perfect for professionals/students. dunkin donuts, chipotle, starbucks, and poke shop neighboring the building

Apartment: 3 private bedrooms all with their own full bath (so no sharing!)

Furnished with: bed, 4 drawers, desk, chair, & living room couch and tv stand

Amenities/other: in-unit washer/dryer, air conditioning, ceiling fans, extra apartment closet/storage area, fully equipped kitchen (fridge, oven, stove, dishwasher), wifi included, apartment balcony, communal sky terrace, pool, jacuzzi, grill, pool table, table tennis, gym, study rooms, printer

Roommates: my other 2 roommates are also planning to sublease so you may have up to 2 roommates with you (or none!)

Don’t hesitate to ask any questions if you’re the slightest bit interested! Willing to negotiate

text:
✨ **LIVE-IN HELPER WANTED | FREE RENT IN EXCHANGE FOR HELP** ✨
📍 **Marina Del Rey, CA**

Looking for a **live-in helper** to stay in our home **rent-free** in exchange for helping care for my mom and assisting with the house. This could be a beautiful fit for someone kind, dependable, and looking for a peaceful place to live in one of LA’s most beautiful areas. 💛

**What’s included:**
🏡 Free room & board in **Marina Del Rey**
🌊 Beautiful location right on the **Harbor Promenade**
💦 Jacuzzi
🏊 Pool
💪 Gym
🛶 Paddle boards
🚲 Bikes

**Help needed with:**
🩷 Diaper changes & toilet assistance
🚿 Bathing assistance when the nurse comes for full baths (1ce a week)
💊 Medication help — morning, sometimes noon, and nightly
🦽 Mobility assistance
🍽️ Meal prep
🧺 Laundry, organizing, dusting
🤖 No sweeping needed — the Roomba handles that
🐶 Dog walking is a bonus, but he’s a big guy, so only if you’re up for it — no pressure

I work from home and am here most of the time, so this is **not a 24/7 situation**. But when I have meetings or events, I do need someone who can be fully present and dependable during those times. I’m flexible and happy to work around your schedule when possible, aside from events I can’t move.

I usually order groceries, so errands would be rare — I mostly just need someone here.

✨ **Caregiving experience is a plus, but I can train the right person**
✨ **Women preferred**
✨ **Non-smoker preferred**

📩 **DM me** or **text 310-919-8233**
Please share — you may know the perfect person. 💛

text:
✨ **LIVE-IN HELPER WANTED | FREE RENT IN EXCHANGE FOR HELP** ✨
📍 **Marina Del Rey, CA**

Looking for a **live-in helper** to stay in our home **rent-free** in exchange for helping care for my mom and assisting with the house. This could be a beautiful fit for someone kind, dependable, and looking for a peaceful place to live in one of LA’s most beautiful areas. 💛

**What’s included:**
🏡 Free room & board in **Marina Del Rey**
🌊 Beautiful location right on the **Harbor Promenade**
💦 Jacuzzi
🏊 Pool
💪 Gym
🛶 Paddle boards
🚲 Bikes

**Help needed with:**
🩷 Diaper changes & toilet assistance
🚿 Bathing assistance when the nurse comes for full baths (1ce a week)
💊 Medication help — morning, sometimes noon, and nightly
🦽 Mobility assistance
🍽️ Meal prep
🧺 Laundry, organizing, dusting
🤖 No sweeping needed — the Roomba handles that
🐶 Dog walking is a bonus, but he’s a big guy, so only if you’re up for it — no pressure

I work from home and am here most of the time, so this is **not a 24/7 situation**. But when I have meetings or events, I do need someone who can be fully present and dependable during those times. I’m flexible and happy to work around your schedule when possible, aside from events I can’t move.

I usually order groceries, so errands would be rare — I mostly just need someone here.

✨ **Caregiving experience is a plus, but I can train the right person**
✨ **Women preferred**
✨ **Non-smoker preferred**

📩 **DM me** or **text 310-919-8233**
Please share — you may know the perfect person. 💛

Woodland Hills Private Full Front House 2BR | Feels Like Your Own Home |$2,975 (Utilities Included)

Enjoy the spacious comfort of a full front house in a peaceful Woodland Hills property. 

This private 2-bedroom, 1-bath setup, offers the feeling of having your own home without the typical shared living dynamic—with the primary tenant residing separately in a private attached back ADU.  Ideal for someone who values calm, privacy and a grounded living environment.

Space Highlights: 
- Private 2-bedroom layout 
- Private bathroom
- Private parking space in driveway 
- Spacious living room 
- Dining room
- Fireplace
- Washer/dryer access
- Central A/C & heat
- Garage storage
- Fenced backyard
- Optional furnished or unfurnished

Living Setup:
- Minimal kitchen sharing (appliances only)
- Primary tenant lives separately in attached rear ADU
- Designed for a low-overlap dynamic, low-traffic, peaceful experience. 

Location:
Prime Woodland Hills location near Ventura Blvd
- Minutes to Topanga Canyon, nature & hiking 
- Close to Whole Foods, Sprouts & Trader Joes
- Near Westfield Mall, restaurants & shops
- Easy 101 access 

Details
- $2,975/month (utilities included)
- 1-Month refundable deposit
- Available May 15th (or sooner)
- 6-12 Month lease preferred
- No smoking / drugs / parties
- No extended or long term guests 
- Pets considered 

Ideal Tenant:
Seeking a financially stable, clean, respectful tenant who values peace, privacy, and a drama-free environment. 

Direct Message for further details or to schedule a viewing if this feels aligned. Open showings next week.

Private room for rent

Room for Rent – Baldwin Hills / Culver City area (Available May 6th)

I’m helping someone find a great roommate for a spacious, peaceful home in Baldwin Hills, near Culver City.

The house has two living rooms, each with a connected fireplace, plus a full kitchen, dining room, brand-new washer and dryer, a large backyard with lots of plants, patio, driveway, and excellent street parking. It’s on a quiet street and only a 5-minute walk to the commuter train.

The available bedroom and bathroom are in the front of the house, and the room comes with what would mostly feel like your own living room. The current occupant lives in the back of the house and primarily uses the back living room and his own bathroom, though shared spaces are always welcome.

He’s a 49-year-old male, works in the film and music industry as well as construction and gardening and lives a very low-key, respectful lifestyle. He doesn’t drink, smoke, or use drugs. He’s considerate, liberal-minded, LGBTQ-friendly, and a genuine ally to all. When home, he mostly meditates, reads, writes, watches TV, or watches sports or gardens. 

He’s lived in Los Angeles for nearly 32 years. The house is mostly furnished, except for the bedroom available, but there’s flexibility if you have furniture of your own for common areas. 

Rent is $1,500/month, including general utilities. 
Unless you use the ac or heater most of time. Landlord would like a 1 year lease.

If this sounds like it could be a good fit, feel free to comment or message me with questions and I’ll connect you directly.

There's a very laid back vibe at the house, your housemates would be:

**Jocque**

My name is Jocque,  I'm 23 years old, I was born and raised in Los Angeles, CA, and graduated from UCSC with a double major in Film and Game Design. I'm a clean, respectful, and easygoing person who values open communication and shared responsibility. I enjoy climbing and exploring the outdoors whenever I get the chance. I enjoy playing video games, reading, writing, and filmmaking. I'm currently not in school at the moment, but I do plan on pursuing a master's degree either in Game design or film.

**Yash**

I'm 23, I'm from MD but graduated from Berkeley last year and I'm starting a PhD in math at USC this year (hoping to find long-term housing since I'll be here for a few years). Besides studying, I play a few instruments and write music, and go out often to concerts, movies, things like that.

I'd say about a 7-8, I don't make much of a mess and I'm usually either out of the house or keeping to myself in my room and studying or writing, but I don't mind if other people aren't super clean as long as its not obtrusive (i.e. I don't mind if people accidentally leave out books or clothes, but dirty dishes cluttering the sink, clothes left too long in the washer/dryer, spills etc I'd rather not deal with).

**Luke** 

"My name is Luke, I'm 22, I'm from Tracy, California, and I graduated from UCSD with a BS in Business Psychology and a minor in Entrepreneurship & Innovation. Before college, I lived in Tracy, CA, where I produced and directed some silly short films and YouTube videos. I currently work remotely as a part-time startup co-founder in the BPO industry and as a reader for UC Berkeley. My long-term goal is to become a movie director, and I'm applying to MFA programs (I'm writing a short film with my current housemate). 1-10 cleanliness, I would an 8 only because ever so often I build set pieces and costumes, so in my personal space, you might see bits and pieces of a build happening.

- Weekends: in and out of house, not much of a homebody unless Im working

- My BF lives in SF and he often visits on weekends. Nice guy.

Living Spaces:

- Always Clean 

Patio:

Kitchen:

Location:

- In Mar Vista, by Venice Beach and Culver City

Laundry:

Apartment Policies

Eligibility

- The room is open to both women and men

text:
Hi guys!

We have a large private room opening soon in the middle of May in a quiet, clean, peaceful home in Van Nuys! The room comes with its own private bathroom, a walk-in closet, and garage parking, so it really feels like your own private space.

The house is in a great community with a super convenient location. A large Target and other everyday essentials are very close by, so errands are easy and everything you need is nearby.

The home is fully equipped with a complete kitchen, all appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, and pretty much everything needed for comfortable day-to-day living. We also have ethernet ports in every room, which is a huge plus if you work from home, game, stream, or just appreciate a strong reliable connection 🎮💻

The household itself is very calm and low key. Everyone here is respectful, professional, introverted, and easy to live with. Most of the time we are in our rooms working, gaming, relaxing, or doing our own thing unless someone is downstairs cooking. It is a very peaceful environment with no parties, no loud gatherings, and no drama, just a genuinely comfortable home where everyone respects each other’s space ✨

Utilities are split four ways and usually come out to around $100 per month. We also have solar, which helps keep electricity lower. Every few months we split gardening costs, which usually comes out to around $30 each when it comes up.

There is one small to medium non-shedding dog in the house, so being a dog lover is important 🐶 No additional pets and no smoking.

We are looking for one person only, not a couple, who is clean, responsible, and easygoing.

The current roommate is moving out around mid-May, so the room will be available after that. Current roommates: 2 male, 1 female.

If this sounds like your kind of space, send a little message about yourself, what you do for work, and what kind of living situation you are looking for! :)

📍 Location: 1201 W 36th Street, Unit B
🚶‍♂️ 5–10 minute walk to University of Southern California (within DPS zone)

💰 Pricing Options:
 • 3 single rooms: $965/person
 • 2 singles + 1 shared room: $786/person

✨ Amenities:
 • Laundry
 • Street parking + parking pass
 • Furnished (bed & table upon request)
 • Dishwasher
 • Fridge & stove

⚡ Utilities: ~$85/month

text:
# **Two Blocks North of Campus! **
## **RECENTLY REMODELED, SPACIOUS 3-BEDROOM, 4-BEDROOM, APARTMENTS, AND TWO 1-BEDROOM COTTAGES IN PRIME LOCATION, TWO BLOCKS NORTH OF USC CAMPUS ON 30TH STREET: PERFECT FOR STUDENTS! YOUR IDEAL OFF-CAMPUS SPOT AWAITS! STONE ON 30TH IS A USC ALUMNI-OWNED PROPERTY. **

Available starting May and August, perfect for students in the class of 2027, 2028, 2029. Each room is private, comes with a queen bed, desk, chair, dining table/island with four high-top dining chairs, and includes a walk-in closet. 

**A female student is seeking two female roommates, clean and friendly. ** Generously sized rooms and a comfortable layout make this an ideal living arrangement for students looking for space, privacy, and a welcoming home environment.

Coming available Fall 2026/2027:** two 3-bedroom apartments, 1 four-bedroom apartment (available August 1), two 1-bedroom cottages, and one has an office. **

Apartment Highlights:
* ***Recently remodeled interiors***** with high ceilings and large windows**
* **Spacious bedrooms and large living rooms, and large kitchens.**
* **Updated kitchens, with custom slow-close cabinets, updated appliances, and plenty of counter space**
* **Updated bathrooms**

**Location Perks:**
* **Just two blocks north of campus and 1.5 blocks from University Village and around the corner from The Row.**
* **A half a block to the new Rawlinson Stadium **
* **In the DPS/CSC protected area with free Lyft access**

**Community Features:**
* **Private security gated property, with a quiet courtyard and gas barbecue **
* **Dual entrances (front and side) and security cameras for added peace of mind**

**Contact Us!**

**Texting and calling are the preferred and fastest forms of communication.**

**If you're interested, have any questions, or would like to set up a tour, please visit our website and call or text us:**

[[https://www.studentlivingsc.com/](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/)](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/) 

**Email: **astone18@me.com

**Call: (424) 436 - 5967**

text:
Hi everyone! My roommate of 3 years is moving out and I am looking for someone interested in filling a spot in a 2-bed, 1-bath apartment in Mid-City on May 1st!

Our apartment is part of a quadplex in a very nice and quiet residential area. It’s got an in-unit washer and dryer, a recently renovated small balcony, plenty of closet space, and lots of windows that give it great natural lighting and airflow. The open bedroom has a ceiling fan, 3 windows, and a full closet. Our neighbors have all been living in this same quadplex for several years and we’re all well taken care of by our very nice landlord and his efforts to keep it fresh and maintained. Rent is $2227 split between two people ($1113.50/ea), and utilities typically cost ~$150 which includes WiFi, gas, and electricity, with the landlord paying for water. The security deposit is $1875, paid to the outgoing roommate, and it along with first month of rent would be due upon move-in. We’d be on a standard year-long lease that could open up to month-to-month later on.

And then finally just a little about me: I’m 24 and work in television post-production in Culver City, about 15min away from the apartment. I work until 7pm every weekday so I’m not often home throughout the day. On weekends when I’m not at home watching movies or playing video games, I swim and play pickleball and just generally try to stay active. I’m very easy-going and clean, and would love a roommate that I can call a friend - all I ask is that you’re clean and respectful!

If you’re interested, please comment and/or DM me so we can chat and set up a walkthrough of the space ASAP; because I’m looking to fill in the room by May 1, I’d like to move quickly. Thanks everyone!

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Fully furnished private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! Conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance.

Common areas are fully furnished! The apartment is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas.

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month after that. There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

I am looking for a female to take over my lease starting /May . The lease starts April/May and can be month to month, and you would have the option to renew for another year if you would like!

> Rent: $1385 + split utilities

text:
🔑 Entire Apartment for Rent – $2,080/mo |  Jefferson Park | Available April 19
This is a fully standalone unit — your own address, your own front door, your own everything.

**About the unit:**

This is not a room in someone's house. This is a completely self-contained 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment at 2034 W 31st St — its own separate unit with its own private entrance

🏠 Entire private apartment — fully self-contained

🚪 Your own private entrance — separate address

🛏️ 1 bedroom / 1 bathroom

📐 ~550 square feet — cozy and functional

🫧 Brand new Samsung washer & dryer — IN UNIT

❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator

🚗 Parking included — backlot

⚡ EV charger — compatible with all vehicles

📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**What makes this different:**

In-unit laundry at this price point in LA is genuinely rare — most 1BDs at $2,080 have shared laundry or nothing. Brand new appliances, your own dedicated parking spot, and an EV charger in the backlot. 

**The location:**

Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for:**

Someone employed or in school, respectful, and clean.

**To apply:**

Security deposit is one month's rent ($2,080). Income requirement is 3x rent ($6,240/mo gross). Proof via pay stubs or bank statements. Pets considered case by case with a meet and greet. Flexible lease terms available — 12-month, 6-month, or month-to-month at different rates.

**Available April 19. DM me to receive the form. Serious inquiries only.**

🏡 Room for Rent – $1,620/mo | West Adams / Jefferson Park | Available April 1
**About the room:**

This is the larger of the two available bedrooms — private, with a shared bathroom. The rest of the house is yours to enjoy.

🛏️** Spacious private bedroom — $1,620/month**

🚿** Shared bathroom (with one other bedroom)**

🛋️** Fully furnished living room**

⚡** EV charger — compatible with all vehicles**

📍** West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA**

**About me:**

I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea. I hire cleaners to keep shared spaces fresh — that cost is on me. Clean, chill home. Looking for someone who matches that.

**The location:**

Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for:**

Someone employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. 

**To apply:**

Security deposit is one month's rent ($1,620). Income requirement is 3x rent ($4,860/mo gross). Proof via pay stubs or bank statements. Pets considered case by case with a meet and greet. Flexible lease terms available — 12-month, 6-month, or month-to-month at different rates.

**Available April 1. DM me to receive the questionnaire. Serious inquiries only.**

text:
Bedroom for Rent in High-Vibration Meditation Home
A chance for blessed person to live onsite at a power spot in Los Angeles and be directly trained by a spiritual master. This is a high vibration house with a sunny bedroom in a peaceful 2 bed / 1 bath home that also serves as a meditation and soul healing center in the Marina Del Rey-Culver City area.

The Room
Your room gets beautiful eastern morning light, filling the space with sunshine to start your day in a really positive way.
• Can be furnished or unfurnished
• If furnished, we can provide: two chairs, bookshelf, and a pull-out couch/bed (as you prefer).

The Home & Vibe

This is a truly special space. The home has pictures and statues of saints and divine souls from multiple traditions—you’ll see Indian saints alongside Jesus and Mary, because we believe in the unity of all religions and welcome those who value truth, right action, peace, and love.

We travel to India regularly and have a second home at an ashram in South India, where we’ve learned ancient healing and meditation techniques through the lineage of avatars Shirdi Sai Baba, Sri Kaleshwar and Jesus. These teachings are designed to bring the mind down and pull balance, positively transform your life experience. heal, care for and grow our soul, love all and serve all, and uplift one another. The purpose of the center is to share these healing and enlightening teachings with those who are open.

We host weekly / bi-monthly / monthly gatherings, and quarterly retreats mostly online to date. The energy of the property is often described as deeply calming, healing, and transformational.

Location

Super convenient for commuting and beach access:
• Right by the 90 and 405 (about 3 minutes to either)
• Immediately off Centinela Blvd
• Close to bus stops, grocery stores, restaurants, parks, gyms
• Straight down Culver Blvd to the beach

Rent & Terms
• $2199/month (plus utilities)
• Security deposit: $2100
• Move-in total: $4,599
• Driveway parking spot
• Lease through at least July 2028

House Guidelines (important)

To keep the home’s purpose and energy consistent:
• Vegetarian household (fish and eggs ok)
• No drugs or alcohol
• No couples
• We’re looking for someone who is either already a meditator or open to learning, and open to helping maintain our home/center’s energy.

Bonus points if you love plants — we have lush indoor and outdoor foliage, and light gardening help is appreciated.

Roommate has been gone abroad on average 3+ months during the year.

Interested? Please reach out if this touches you and send a message with a little about you, as well as answers to the below questions:
1. If you have a job/what is it/typical hours?
2. Are you a meditator/like to learn?
3. When would you like to move in (open now through June. Lease signed by April 30 move in anytime through June 30).

About You: We are looking for an easy going, relaxed, clean, honest and light-hearted team-player who meditates daily and is open to meeting new people. Optimally you are someone who wants to deepen your connection with the divine and your own soul and engage in our soul-growing events. Ideally you want to participate in maintaining the energy and help clean the house, water plants, etc. Someone, for example, who helps puts dishes away, takes out the trash, and home duties. You are a vegetarian. Bonus points if you like gardening or yard work (or would like to improve your green thumb). We prefer someone who either works and/or goes to school. Someone who pays bills on time and is respectful and tidy.

About Your Roommate: Your other roommate is a friendly + thoughtful master meditator, Eastern alternative Doctor, healer and teacher. She has been living a lot in India the last 20 years. She is a full time meditation teacher and healer of these divine channels who works from this home when she is residing here. She leads spiritual journeys abroad and has been traveling an average 3+ months of the year bridging the Eastern wisdom in the West. She leads classes and events online and in-person. She loves being of service, being in nature, is social, kombucha, and loves sharing meals and positive experiences with people.

JUST LISTED FALLBROOK! 🏡

Rare Opportunity in Pala Mesa Villas!

Beautifully updated single-story, ground-level condo with no neighbors above or below, offering the privacy and feel of a single-family home in one of Fallbrook’s most desirable golf course communities.

This spacious 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom home with approximately 1,156 sq ft features a bright open layout, newer upgraded carpet, and a seamless flow from the kitchen to the living area—perfect for both relaxing and entertaining. Large windows bring in abundant natural light and showcase peaceful views of lush greenery and nearby hills.

Step outside to your private patio retreat, ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation in a tranquil, resort-style setting.

Located in the highly sought-after Pala Mesa Villas within the Pala Mesa golf course area, the community offers pool, spa, tennis courts, BBQ areas, and scenic walking paths, all surrounded by beautifully maintained grounds. Water is included through the HOA, adding value and convenience.

Prime location near golf, dining, wineries, and the Pala Mesa Resort, with easy access to I-15 and Highway 76, making it ideal for commuters, a second home, or investment.

Homes in this community rarely offer this level of privacy, location, and lifestyle—don’t miss this opportunity.

text:
Hi! I’m a first-year student looking for a private room in an all-female USC student shared housing arrangement for this summer (mid-may to mid-august). I’ll be working full-time and volunteering in a lab so I would be out during the daytime.

My budget is $800–$1100, and I’m specifically looking for a summer sublease near USC’s main campus. I’m only interested in subleasing with USC students.

I’m clean, respectful, and very communicative with housemates. If you’re subleasing or know of any available spots that is leased by a USC student, please feel free to DM me. Thank you!

text:
Hi! I’m looking for a non-smoking FEMALE roommate to take over my spot in a 3 bed / 1.5 bath house (the other two roommates are staying!)

The house has a fully furnished living room, dining area, and kitchen. The bedroom (11x19) is unfurnished and has direct access to the half bathroom, which is super convenient. There’s also a washer/dryer, a huge backyard, garage storage, and plenty of driveway + street parking. The room itself is huge and it’s connected to a little office room, but you can turn￼ it to anything you want doesn’t have to be an office. 

You’d be living with two women — one works at USC and has been renting the house for about 8 years, and the other is a recent USC grad student who’s a bit of a night owl. Both are really respectful and easy to live with, and the landlord is super responsive and kind. Honestly, this place is such a good deal for the price. I’d stay longer if I could, but I have to move closer to Pasadena for work. The neighborhood is really quiet and the neighbors are so sweet.

The house is near the Leimert Park area, about 3 miles from USC, and the K Line metro station is about a 10-minute walk.

Rent is $1200 + utilities (usually around $150/month per person). Available June 1 with a one-year lease. Move-in is first month’s rent + a deposit equal to one month’s rent.

Single occupancy only, no pets please!

Feel free to message me if you’re interested or have any questions 😊
