text:
Room for rent in 5bed/2bath house near USC

-   available April 15th for a 4 1/2 month lease until August 31st, 2026 (renewable for a year after that)

-   the room rents for $1,150  per month
-   the deposit is one month's rent
-   the house has 5 bedrooms and 2 shared bathrooms

-   the rooms are all single

-   utilities, parking, weekly housekeeping and weekly gardening are all included in
    rent
-  no pets are allowed

-  1454 w 36th, Los Angeles CA 90018

There's a very laid back vibe at the house, your housemates would be:

**Jocque**

My name is Jocque,  I'm 23 years old, I was born and raised in Los Angeles, CA, and graduated from UCSC with a double major in Film and Game Design. I'm a clean, respectful, and easygoing person who values open communication and shared responsibility. I enjoy climbing and exploring the outdoors whenever I get the chance. I enjoy playing video games, reading, writing, and filmmaking. I'm currently not in school at the moment, but I do plan on pursuing a master's degree either in Game design or film.

**Yash**

I'm 23, I'm from MD but graduated from Berkeley last year and I'm starting a PhD in math at USC this year (hoping to find long-term housing since I'll be here for a few years). Besides studying, I play a few instruments and write music, and go out often to concerts, movies, things like that.

I'd say about a 7-8, I don't make much of a mess and I'm usually either out of the house or keeping to myself in my room and studying or writing, but I don't mind if other people aren't super clean as long as its not obtrusive (i.e. I don't mind if people accidentally leave out books or clothes, but dirty dishes cluttering the sink, clothes left too long in the washer/dryer, spills etc I'd rather not deal with).

**Luke** 

"My name is Luke, I'm 22, I'm from Tracy, California, and I graduated from UCSD with a BS in Business Psychology and a minor in Entrepreneurship & Innovation. Before college, I lived in Tracy, CA, where I produced and directed some silly short films and YouTube videos. I currently work remotely as a part-time startup co-founder in the BPO industry and as a reader for UC Berkeley. On the weekends, I PA for film projects in LA, which is why I am moving here from San Diego. My long-term goal is to become a movie director, and I'm applying to MFA programs (I'm writing a short film with my current housemate). In my free time, I enjoy watching movies, gaming, reading, and playing guitar. I love all types of music, especially pop-punk and metal. I also occasionally go line dancing and raving."

**Clifford**

My name is Clifford, I’m from San Antonio, Texas and I’m in the United States Army Reserve, a musical theater composer/Live Sound Audio Engineer, a supervisor at a local restaurant as well as a private piano instructor. I’ve spent most of my life around the world, being a child of a military family. After joining the military, I was stationed in Korea, and Europe for most of my career, so it’s given me the opportunity to see the world and meet all different kinds of people and cultures. You can drop a pin somewhere in Europe and I’ve probably been there. 

If I’m not working I’m spending most of my days, practicing working on my craft, or hiking, even line dancing at a local bar I frequent. I’m quiet for the most part when not practicing and very clean. I’ve got my associates in Music Production and am currently going to LA FILM for my bachelors in Audio Engineering, with the intentions of eventually getting my masters. I love learning. I also love and enjoy a sense of community. So I’m definitely a people person for sure. 

1-10 cleanliness, I would an 8 only because ever so often I build set pieces and costumes, so in my personal space, you might see bits and pieces of a build happening. 

------

Everybody is in their early to mid twenties, and rooms usually go quickly when they become available.

- Utilities and Parking are included in rent

- Weekly Housekeeping and Gardening ( the housekeepers clean the common areas, kitchen and bathrooms)

- On site laundry facilities

- Individual AC/heater in every room

- High speed wireless internet throughout the house

- Awesome yard with lots of plants and a BBQ

- stacked parking for 5 cars in the driveway

- Music studio in the back (not part of rent)

- Cool, laid back roommates

- Students and recent graduates transitioning to the working world welcome!

- Young film makers have used the house as a location on several occasions.

For rental applications please contact Jan Pauck

Looking to finalize someone this week for an April 1 move-in.

**1-Bedroom Apartment in the best of West Hollywood**. 

**SHORT TERM RENTAL.** 

Nestled in the heart of West Hollywood, this 1-bedroom apartment offers a perfect blend of comfort and convenience. With a warm and welcoming atmosphere, the space is thoughtfully furnished, featuring a comfortable queen-sized bed, a cozy living area, and all the essentials for a relaxing stay.

Enjoy high-speed WiFi, Netflix, and YouTube for entertainment, plus the convenience of a dedicated garage parking spot. Located just two blocks from Melrose Place, you'll be steps away from high-end shopping, trendy cafés, and some of LA’s best dining spots.

Ideal for anyone looking for a peaceful, well-located home in one of the most desirable neighborhoods in the city.  

Availability: Flexible – from May to October

Price: $2900 (negotiable)

DM me for details & availability!

text:
Hello! I am subletting my very spacious, fully furnished room with wall-length mirrors and tons of closet space in a 3b/2b apartment in Brentwood!

🗓 Dates: June 21 – August 7th (slightly flexible if needed)
💰 Rent: $1650/ month (covers all utilities and furnishings!)
📍 Location: Brentwood area! Very close to public transportation, walkable area with cute shops and restaurants, easy access to UCLA / Expo Line / Santa Monica, etc.

The room is a super large cozy master bedroom with its own bathroom. It will come furnished with a comfy queen sized bed, huge closet, and decor (rug, plants, tables, etc). The apartment is shared with 2 respectful, easygoing female roommates who are both SMC students in their early 20s. One roommate has a small cat who’s very friendly.

We’re looking for someone who is:
• Clean, responsible, and communicative
• Respectful of shared spaces and a generally calm home environment

Ideal for a female student or working professional needing a short-term stay in a great area. It’s about a 10 minute walk to San Vicente shops and restaurants, 10 min drive to ucla, 10 min drive to Santa Monica and the beach. 

Message me with a little about yourself if interested!

text:
🏡 Looking for 2 Roommates – Rooms from $1,280/mo | Near USC
Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space.

**About the rooms: **
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

🛏️ Larger bedroom — **$1,620/month (Utilities not included)**
🛏️ Smaller bedroom — **$1,280/month (Utilities not included)**
🚿 Shared bathroom (between the 2 rooms only) 
🛋️ Fully furnished living room 🍽️ Full dining room setup 
🍳 Fully stocked kitchen 
🧹 Professional cleaners provided — on me, not you 
🫧 Brand new Samsung washer & dryer — IN UNIT
❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator 
🚗 Parking included — backlot 
⚡ EV charger — compatible with all vehicles 
📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**About me:**
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea.
 

**The location:** 
Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

**What I'm looking for: **
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup. 

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Fully furnished private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! Conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance.

Common areas are fully furnished! The apartment is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas.

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month after that. There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

text:
🏡 Looking for 2 Roommates – Rooms from $1,280/mo | Near USC on 31st street and western

Looking for 2 roommates to join a 3-bedroom home in Jefferson park. Both rooms are available now and I'd love to find two people who get along and fit the energy of the space. 

About the rooms:
Both bedrooms are private with a shared bathroom between the two of them. The rest of the house — living room, dining room, kitchen — is fully shared and fully set up.

🛏️ Larger bedroom — $1,620/month (Utilities not included)
🛏️ Smaller bedroom — $1,280/month (Utilities not included)🚿 Shared bathroom (between the 2 rooms only)

🛋️ Fully furnished living room 
🍽️ Full dining room setup
🍳 Fully stocked kitchen
🧹 Professional cleaners provided — on me, not you🫧 Brand new Samsung washer & dryer — IN UNIT
❄️ Brand new Samsung refrigerator
🚗 Parking included — backlot
⚡ EV charger — compatible with all vehicles
📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA 

About me:
I'm Kevin, 29 — a designer in tech who works mostly from home. I take care of this place and I'm looking for someone who appreciates that — clean, laid back, and genuinely good to be around. I work from home most days or a nearby gym library — so the house is calm and lived in, not empty. Up by 8–9am, in bed by midnight. I go to the gym 3-4 times a week, go out on weekends, and travel regularly for snowboarding, hiking, weddings, and family trips to Korea.

The location:
Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Metro E Line nearby for car-free commutes. Walking distance to Highly Likely, Cento Pasta Bar, Farmhouse Kitchen Thai, and Mizlala. One of the most central and underrated neighborhoods in LA.

What I'm looking for:
Two people who are employed or in school, respectful of shared spaces, and easy to live with. You don't have to know each other — I'm open to filling each room separately. But if you're two friends or colleagues looking to share a home together, this is a great setup.

DM me @kevinlee063 on insta or message me on facebook if interested. Serious inquiries only.

text:
# **Two Blocks North of Campus! **
## **RECENTLY REMODELED, SPACIOUS 3-BEDROOM, 4-BEDROOM, APARTMENTS, AND TWO 1-BEDROOM COTTAGES IN PRIME LOCATION, TWO BLOCKS NORTH OF USC CAMPUS ON 30TH STREET: PERFECT FOR STUDENTS! YOUR IDEAL OFF-CAMPUS SPOT AWAITS! STONE ON 30TH IS A USC ALUMNI-OWNED PROPERTY. **

Available starting May and August, perfect for students in the class of 2027, 2028, 2029. Each room is private, comes with a queen bed, desk, chair, dining table/island with four high-top dining chairs, and includes a walk-in closet. 

**A female student is seeking two female roommates, clean and friendly. ** Generously sized rooms and a comfortable layout make this an ideal living arrangement for students looking for space, privacy, and a welcoming home environment.

Coming available Fall 2026/2027:** two 3-bedroom apartments, 1 four-bedroom apartment (available August 1), two 1-bedroom cottages, and one has an office. **

Apartment Highlights:
* ***Recently remodeled interiors***** with high ceilings and large windows**
* **Spacious bedrooms and large living rooms, and large kitchens.**
* **Updated kitchens, with custom slow-close cabinets, updated appliances, and plenty of counter space**
* **Updated bathrooms**

**Location Perks:**
* **Just two blocks north of campus and 1.5 blocks from University Village and around the corner from The Row.**
* **A half a block to the new Rawlinson Stadium **
* **In the DPS/CSC protected area with free Lyft access**

**Community Features:**
* **Private security gated property, with a quiet courtyard and gas barbecue **
* **Dual entrances (front and side) and security cameras for added peace of mind**

**Contact Us!**

**Texting and calling are the preferred and fastest forms of communication.**

**If you're interested, have any questions, or would like to set up a tour, please visit our website and call or text us:**

groupTitle: LOS ANGELES ROOMS FOR RENT

text:
We have a large private room available soon in middle of May in a quiet, clean home for $1,650. The room comes with its own private bathroom, a walk in closet, and garage parking.

The house is in a nice community in Van Nuys and the location is really convenient. There is a large Target very close by along with other shopping and everyday essentials, so errands are easy.

Utilities are split four ways and usually come out to around $100 a month. We also have solar, which helps keep electricity lower. Every few months we also split gardening costs, which is usually about $30 each, so it ends up being a small extra amount per person when it comes up.

The house is very calm and peaceful. Everyone here is professional, respectful, and low key. Most of the time we are just in our rooms playing video games, working, or doing our own thing unless someone is downstairs cooking. It is a very easygoing household and everyone respects each other’s space. No parties, no loud gatherings, and no drama.

There is one small to medium non shedding dog in the house, so you definitely need to be a dog lover. No additional pets and no smoking.

We are looking for one person only, not a couple, who is clean, responsible, and easy to live with.

If interested, send a little about yourself, what you do for work, and what kind of living situation you are looking for! :)

**29376 Via Frontera, Murrieta, CA 92563**

Beautifully upgraded single-story **end-unit condo** located in the highly desirable Murrieta Hot Springs area. This 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom home features a bright and open layout with **soaring vaulted ceilings and exposed beam**, creating a spacious and inviting living space filled with natural light.

The completely remodeled **modern kitchen** showcases sleek **waterfall-style countertops**, upgraded white cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a functional layout that opens seamlessly to the living and dining areas—perfect for entertaining.

The living room features a **stylish upgraded fireplace** and multiple windows and sliding doors that enhance the indoor-outdoor flow. Enjoy **three sliding glass doors** leading to **two private patios**, ideal for relaxing or hosting guests.

Additional upgrades include **new flooring throughout**, **remodeled bathrooms**, **new windows**, **recessed lighting**, central A/C & heat, and **interior laundry**. The unit also includes a **1-car garage conveniently located nearby**.

The community offers a **pool and spa area with lounging space**, surrounded by mature landscaping and greenbelt areas. Located adjacent to a scenic golf course, this home provides a peaceful setting while still being close to everything.

Conveniently located near shopping centers, restaurants, parks, and with easy access to major freeways. Just minutes from **Temecula Wine Country**, award-winning wineries, golf courses, and entertainment. Nearby **Lake Skinner** offers boating, fishing, hiking, and year-round events including the Balloon & Wine Festival.

ROOM AVAILABLE IN PRIME WEST LA LOCATION!
We’ve secured a 3-bedroom, 2-bath apartment and are now looking for a 4th roommate (two girls are sharing a room downstairs) to take over the room shown in the photos. You would be sharing the bathroom (with shower) with just one other girl living upstairs. 

 Location: Perfectly situated between Sawtelle & Brentwood

 Rent: $1850/month + utilities

 Move-in: ASAP, preferably before April 15
The apartment is super nice, spacious, and in a great area close to everything. It has two big outdoor terrace not shown in the photos. 
We’re looking for someone who is clean, respectful, and easygoing, and who wants to be part of a fun but still chill and organized home.
If you think you’d be a great fit, message me on Instagram for more photos & details!

Welcome to USC. They have security patrols 24/7  2 miles around the campus. Look for housing near the Village, walking distance. I am familiar with Gateway. USC houses students there and you can also privately lease there on your own. It is directly across the street from the campus an and next to the shrine. If you want to look them up online and look up university Gateway. There is also a USC parent and family page you may post in. The safest areas are probably closer to Campos just because you have DPS. you can look up the official DPS patrol maps to see the exact areas that they cover. The area is closest to USC campus have students and people out and about at all hours so while nowhere is 100% guaranteed safe it is probably safest to live near where there is always a security presence

Private Bedroom in EaHo/Silver Lake!
Hey everyone! We’re looking for a new roommate to join our 3-bedroom spot right on Melrose. The apartment is 3 blocks from Hollywood, 10 mins to DTLA, and super close to the Metro. You’ll have a private bedroom that can come furnished with a bed/frame or be totally empty for your own setup. You’d be sharing the place with two guys. We keep a calm, tidy, pet-free, and smoke-free home. I’m big on seasonal decorating and the occasional group dinner, so we’re looking for someone who is friendly but also appreciates a peaceful home base.

Details:

• Rent: $1,150 (it includes all the utilities).

• Lease: 6-month minimum sublease (we like keeping things flexible).

• Security: Fully refundable deposit.

We’re looking for:

• Someone with a steady job/income, or financial aid letters are totally fine for students! Good credit, and a respectful, clean lifestyle.

If this sounds like a good fit, shoot me a DM! Tell me a little bit about yourself, what you do for work/fun, and what your typical schedule looks like.

text:
Hi! My roommate is moving, and I’m looking for someone to sublease her unfurnished room in a 2-bed, 1-bath apartment in the heart of West Hollywood! This is an incredible location off Fairfax and Santa Monica Blvd. It’s an incredibly safe, walkable area, and you’ll be steps away from the WeHo Farmers Market, The Grove, Whole Foods, Target, the Melrose Trading Post, and all the best bars, restaurants, and shops on Santa Monica Blvd. It is such an awesome apartment!
The Details:
• Rent: $1,440/month + utilities (~$100)
• Parking: Closed garage parking included! 🤩
• Availability: Looking for someone to move in May 1st. Currently month-to-month, but we can start a new long-term lease together if you'd prefer. I’ll prioritize candidates who will stay long term. 
• Amenities: On-site washer/dryer, dishwasher, and a kitchen with stainless steel appliances.
• The Space: Massive living room, bedroom, and closet with great natural lighting and full-length mirrors.
• Outdoor Space: Private patio/balcony (the unit is technically on the second floor, but sits three stories up).
About the Household:
You will be living with me and my two sweet cats 🙂
• Me: I’m in my early 30s and a PhD student. I’m clean, tidy, and generally social, though I definitely value my alone time as well. Every once in a while I’ll have a friend or two over, but I’m not into loud partying at home.
• The Cats: They are both social, though one is a bit more outgoing than the other. They are both so sweet! I really love and care for them, so if you’re a cat person, that’s a huge plus!
What I’m Looking For:
• Communication: Someone who values open and easy communication.
• Boundaries: Respect for each other’s space and privacy.
• Cleanliness: I’m not a total clean-freak, but I really appreciate someone who cleans up after themselves and keeps the common spaces tidy.

Girls only, and no more pets unfortunately.

Looking forward to hearing from you! 🙂

text:
Looking for a reliable roommate in Burbank (91505) 🏡✨
My husband and I have a furnished private bedroom and private bathroom available in our 3-bedroom 2-bathroom home.
• Rent: $1,600/month. Not including utilities. 
• Location: Near downtown Burbank. Minutes away from Smart and Final, Porto’s, Costco, Trader Joe’s, Target, and Ralphs.
• Lease term: Flexible move-in date and lease length. 
• Full access to shared living spaces, backyard, and in-home washer/dryer. Street parking is easy and available.

We are a quiet, tidy couple in our mid-20s. I'm pursuing a career in nursing. My husband, Dylan, is a Data Analyst who works from home. We have three cats and keep the house very clean (frequent vacuuming and mopping). We mostly enjoy watching TV, reading, climbing, and playing board games. You’re always welcome to join our occasional game nights, but we totally respect your need for privacy and downtime! Vaping is fine in the home, but please smoke cigarettes/weed outside.

If this sounds like a good fit for you, DM me! We'd love to chat and show you the space!

Hi everyone! 👋 I’m on the hunt for a cozy spot in Manhattan Beach or the South Bay area. 🌊
I’m looking to move in as soon as possible, ideally by April 1st.
Quick details:
🏠 Type: ADU, Guest House, Back House, Duplex, or a Master Bedroom.
🛁 Must-haves: Ideally a balcony and a private bathroom (so I can keep the litter box in my own space without bothering anyone).
💰 Budget: Around $1,400/month. (Looking for month-to-month at first to make sure we’re a good fit!).
🐾 The roommates: I have two sweet, well-behaved, and fully vaccinated cats. They’re litter-trained and very chill. If I rent a Master Bedroom, I’m looking for a home where they can freely roam around and feel comfortable.
A little about me:
I’m a reliable, tidy, and independent guy. I live a very quiet and clean lifestyle — I don't drink, don't use drugs, and I don't host parties or bring guests over.
I’m gay, so I’m totally comfortable sharing a home with anyone, whether you’re male or female — it makes no difference to me as long as we respect each other's space.
I really value peace, quiet, and personal boundaries. I’m also pretty handy! I’m happy to help with chores or property maintenance if you have a private house. I have all my documents ready, along with solid references from my work and previous landlords.
Honesty and sincerity are super important to me. I’m an open book and happy to answer any additional questions you might have!
If you have a lead or know someone with a vacancy, please shoot me a DM. I’d love to chat! 📩
Thanks for the help! 🙏❤️🤗

🌿 Conscious House/Pet Sitting Opportunity + Beautiful West LA Stay 🌿

Hi community,

I’m looking for a responsible, grounded, and respectful person to stay in my home and care for pets while I travel.

📍 Location: West LA (Sawtelle area), adjacent to Santa Monica & Brentwood
— 5–7 min drive to the beach
— 2 blocks from Expo line
— Park at end of block (pool, tennis, pickleball, volleyball)
— Fully gated home with beautiful front & back garden

🗓 Dates:
• June 29 – July 11
(Arrive June 29, depart July 11)

Potential for additional dates:
• Late July – mid August (ideal if same person is available)

✨ The Space:
Private room in a full house (not an apartment), peaceful garden, all amenities included.

🐾 Responsibilities (approx. <1 hour/day):
• Feed and let dogs out (morning & before sundown)
• Light cleanup in garden
• Feed fish
• Water plants
• Leave home clean (or cleaner than you found it)
• Occasional care for outdoor feral cat (food/water) & pictures/videos sent of pets 

💫 Energy I’m looking for:
Someone clean, reliable, communicative, and genuinely respectful of space and animals. This is important.

💰 Exchange:
Discounted stay: $500 for the full period
 • refundable deposit (returned upon completion of agreed care)

This is a beautiful opportunity for someone wanting a peaceful, well-located place over the 4th of July in LA, in exchange for light, consistent care.

📩 Please message me with:
• A bit about yourself
• Your experience with pets/housesitting
• References 

I will be doing a short call to make sure it’s a good mutual fit.

Thank you 🙏

text:
Private room for rent

Room for Rent – Baldwin Hills / Culver City area (Available May 6th)

I’m helping someone find a great roommate for a spacious, peaceful home in Baldwin Hills, near Culver City.

The house has two living rooms, each with a connected fireplace, plus a full kitchen, dining room, brand-new washer and dryer, a large backyard with lots of plants, patio, driveway, and excellent street parking. It’s on a quiet street and only a 5-minute walk to the commuter train.

The available bedroom and bathroom are in the front of the house, and the room comes with what would mostly feel like your own living room. The current occupant lives in the back of the house and primarily uses the back living room and his own bathroom, though shared spaces are always welcome.

He’s a 49-year-old male, works in the film and music industry as well as construction and gardening and lives a very low-key, respectful lifestyle. He doesn’t drink, smoke, or use drugs. He’s considerate, liberal-minded, LGBTQ-friendly, and a genuine ally to all. When home, he mostly meditates, reads, writes, watches TV, or watches sports or gardens. 

He’s lived in Los Angeles for nearly 32 years. The house is mostly furnished, except for the bedroom available, but there’s flexibility if you have furniture of your own for common areas. 

Rent is $1,500/month, including general utilities. 
Unless you use the ac or heater most of time. Landlord would like a 1 year lease.

If this sounds like it could be a good fit, feel free to comment or message me with questions and I’ll connect you directly.
Please, no scams or bots. 🙏🏼

groupTitle: USC Off-Campus Housing

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Fully furnished private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! Conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance.

Common areas are fully furnished! The apartment is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas.

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month after that. There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

3711 Baldwin St., Los Angeles, CA

Rent: $1,020 includes all utilities, WIFI, furniture & parking

* Refundable deposit: $1,000
* Cleaning fee: $120 (deduct from deposit)

No payment due before signing of lease

Single occupancy bedroom on 1st floor - see Rm 1 on floor plan
* Share bathroom with 1 male housemate

* Central AC, washer/dryer in garage
* Community pool & heated jacuzzi

_______________
**HOUSEMATES**
You will share the house with 3 male graduate students:
Rm 2: USC MD 2026

No pets.
_______________
**CONTACT**
Message or email the property manager, Imei, to schedule an open house appointment: imei@cvtliving.com

✅ Provide your school or work info for an open house visit
✅ Provide proof of funds / income for living expenses to sign sublease

Thank you! 😀

Our **By-the-Bed / Co-Living Units** near University of Southern California are designed to fit your lifestyle—whether you prefer something **fully furnished** or want the freedom of an **unfurnished space**.

** Unfurnished Units**

# **Two Blocks North of Campus! **
## **RECENTLY REMODELED, SPACIOUS 3-BEDROOM APARTMENTS IN PRIME LOCATION, TWO BLOCKS NORTH OF USC CAMPUS: PERFECT FOR STUDENTS! YOUR IDEAL OFF-CAMPUS SPOT AWAITS! STONE ON 30TH IS A USC ALUMNI-OWNED PROPERTY. **

Available starting May and August, perfect for students in the class of 2027, 2028, 2029. Each room is private, comes with a queen bed, desk, chair, dining table/island with four high-top dining chairs, and includes a walk-in closet. 

A female student is seeking two female roommates, and a male is seeking two male or female roommates, to each share a spacious three-bedroom apartment. Generously sized rooms and a comfortable layout make this an ideal living arrangement for students looking for space, privacy, and a welcoming home environment.

Coming available Fall 2026/2027: two 3-bedroom apartments, 1 four-bedroom apartment, two 1-bedroom houses, and one has an office. 

Apartment Highlights:
* ***Recently remodeled interiors***** with high ceilings and large windows**
* **Spacious bedrooms and large living rooms, and large kitchens.**
* **Updated kitchens, with custom slow-close cabinets, updated appliances, and plenty of counter space**
* **Updated bathrooms**

**Location Perks:**
* **Just two blocks north of campus and 1.5 blocks from University Village and around the corner from The Row.**
* **A half a block to the new Rawlinson Stadium **
* **In the DPS/CSC protected area with free Lyft access**

**Community Features:**
* **Private security gated property, with a quiet courtyard and gas barbecue **
* **Dual entrances (front and side) and security cameras for added peace of mind**

**Contact Us!**

**Texting and calling are the preferred and fastest forms of communication.**

**If you're interested, have any questions, or would like to set up a tour, please visit our website and call or text us:**

[[https://www.studentlivingsc.com/](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/)](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/)

text:
Mid-Century Modern Rooms in Encino – Peaceful, Stylish, Great Vibes!

Looking for a calm, comfy home with great energy and design? 

Join this newly renovated Mid-Century Modern house in a quiet, tree-lined pocket neighborhood part of Encino. 

Built in 1955 on the old RKO Studios Ranch lot where the Christmas Classic movie “It’s A Wonderful Life” was filmed. 

Palm Springs feel, all-new furnishings, and a respectful, friendly atmosphere.

Pricing per each rental room below is based on a one person per room occupancy. A couple in a room will have an additional 15% fee added to the monthly rental totals below for the additional facilities usage by 2 people. 
 
Room Availability:

New York Room – $1,400/mo

(New York Room is currently available)

San Francisco Room - N/A

(San Francisco Room is now rented)

Each of the above are ~140 sq ft | Fully furnished | Luxury motorized bed | Bright, cozy
Pool + backyard access  

New York Room and San Francisco Room share a  spacious bathroom w/ dual sinks. 

Cairo Room – $1,700/mo 

(Cairo Room is currently available)

~198 sq ft | Furnished | Luxury motorized bed | Bright, cozy |
Pool + backyard access.

Cairo Room has a private en suite bathroom

The House:

– 2,218 sq ft open layout
- 4 total bedrooms (owner lives in primary bedroom)
– 10,000+ sq ft corner lot with lots of peaceful outdoor space
– Vintage-modern furnishings
– Fully furnished kitchen, in-home laundry
– Saltwater pool + in-pool hot tub
– Smart home tech, digital keypad entry door and room locks
– Entertainment system for movie nights, fast Wi-Fi
– Easy and plentiful street parking
 
Nearby:

– Sepulveda Basis Recreation Area with 3 well maintained public golf courses, tennis and basketball courts, baseball and soccer fields, biking and hiking paths, paddle boating, archery, model airplanes
– Easy 101 and 405 freeway access
– Nearby Park & Ride connection to L.A. Metro system
– Universal Studios Hollywood
– Burbank Airport
– Walk to Trader Joe’s and Tapia Bros (a local family farm and market)
– Close to Ventura Blvd and all of its shops, restaurants, coffee houses, and business services.
 
About Me (Live-In Owner):

Chill, respectful, well-traveled (39 countries), fitness enthusiast, outdoor adventure fan, recreational baseball player, lifelong Dodgers fan. 

I keep the house clean and welcoming, and want both men and women to feel safe and comfortable here.

Details:

– 31 day minimum month rental required.  90+ day rental preferred.

– Utilities and home services split evenly (25% per person, for up to 4 people, including me in the 4, and divided evenly for owner + tenant totals above 4 people)

– 1-month security deposit +$350 cleaning/utilities/home services deposit

– Rental application and lease agreement required

– Tenant must have renter’s insurance throughout whole lease. Lemonade has very affordable renter's insurance policies. My previous tenants have used them. 

– No smoking/vaping on premises (in the home or on the property lot)

– No pets
  
If this sounds like your kind of place, send a quick note—would love to connect!

text:
Guest Bedroom In 2 Bedroom 1 Bath Available Now

I have a newly renovated guest room available in my  2 bedroom 1 bath apartment in Glassell Park. This room is available for $1,200, this is an all inclusive price. This includes wifi water and power. I am a server at a restaurant and am studying digital design and digital marketing at Los Angeles Valley College. I am looking for a room mate who is clean and professional like myself. I clean the apartment often and would love to stay on this area if I can. Where I am located within Glassell Park I am very close to Atwater Village, Echo Park, Silverlake, Highland Park, Glendale, and Eagle Rock. There are a lot of really cool creatives in this area specifically. The apartment is very close to Little Ripper, a cute coffee shop that does all kinds of fun community pop ups and events. Laundry is on site, parking is close and ample. The courtyards are magical during the day time and all of my neighbors are kind. The neighborhood is also great for walking and during any given day of the week you will see people out and walking. I added a photo of the room with a bed and some furniture for reference. Since the room doesn’t have the largest closet I am willing to allow whom ever rents the room to use the two larger closets in the hallways as well. Deposit $600. I am looking to have someone move in by April 5th!

text:
Hiya🙋‍♀️
  I'm subletting my room in this beautiful and sunny House on the border of Silverlake and Echo Park! 
#1 “Your Room” ~ Spacious with an en-suite bathroom with a bathtub, and a big window wall that looks out onto the front porch, some flower bushes, and the sunset. This room is fully furnished.
#2 “The Study” ~ Here there is a record player, Musical Instruments, Our library, a big open rug for dancing, and a big mirror to photograph all the fun. This is my favorite room in the house because you can spread out on the floor to play games, cry, or get yourself up and dance with your friends. 
#3 “The Living Room” ~ A functional fireplace, a functional 1920’s piano, two comfy couches and a cozy Moroccan rug. This room is most used for lounging and watching movies.
#4 “The Kitchen” ~ Round dining table, modern fridge, granite counter tops, loads of cabinet space, garbage disposal, dishwasher, and a mini deck off the back door that lets bright sun and rainbows in🌈! 
#5 Bonus Mentions ~ street parking is ample, our neighbors are cool, and we have a great washer/dryer set off the guest bathroom. Utilities include wifi, ladwp, and gas and come to about $70 per person per month. The property is secure with cameras and a high-level security system.

I will be gone from May through August. My incomparable roommate is Cassidy, a witty and beautiful soul who makes this home what it is, cozy and full of love and laughter. She is a dynamite lady and whoever gets to live with her this summer is lucky lucky! 

If you are interested, please message me about yourself, why you are moving, and what your daily life looks like. I will share more about us as well! Thanks and happy hunting!

text:
**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a short or long-term roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! No pets allowed, unfortunately. The apartment is conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance. 

Common areas are fully furnished! The space is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas. I love animals, but no pets allowed unfortunately! 

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month beginning July 1st (if you decide to stay longer). There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a Zoom or FaceTime tour so you can see the place and we can chat!

AFFORDABLE HOUSING WALKING DISTANCE TO USC! Room for rent move in May-June 2026.
**Why the Room is Available:**
I’m moving out and opening up a spot in the house (I graduated a year ago and stuck around for a bit)! Looking for a replacement to snag this spot right next to USC as THIS IS A RENT CONTROLLED TOWNHOUSE, MAJOR SAVINGS!!!

**Why This Unit is Special:**
This is a rent-controlled unit that has been transferred on through friends and word of mouth to prevent rent increase between leases. This is a hard to find price, and has IN UNIT LAUNDRY!!

**Details:**
* **Unit:** Upper-level 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom apartment (stairs, no ramp access).
* **Shared Spaces:** Furnished living room and kitchen with in-unit washer and dryer.
* **Move-in Date:** May-June 2026
* **Rent:** $916.63/month.
* **Room Size:** 130 sq. ft. private room. Walk in closet with installed clothing rack and shelf. Ceilings are 9 ft.
* **Entire Unit Size:** 1,265 sq. ft.
* **Utilities:** $20–$60 per person, depending on usage.

* **Air Conditioned: **I just installed a brand new window A/C in the room in Nov 2025, I can leave it behind for you already installed if you want to buy it off me for a discounted price.

* PhD student, dental student, and academic staff (researcher). All male.

All dedicated students/professionals and respectful roommates. We accommodate each other however needed, respect personal space, and keep things clean (we also hire cleaners once a month).

**Who We’re Looking For:**

1 roommate (male or female) to move into a private bedroom, and to share the larger bathroom. Keeps communal areas tidy. Friendly, respectful, and willing to communicate with the roommates about any needs/plans/issues if ever something comes up. Financially responsible and able to pay rent/utilities on time. PRIVATE BEDROOM & PRIVATE BATHROOM NEAR USC (Female Subleaser Only)
I am looking for a female student to sublease my room in my LA apartment from close to the USC campus, as I am relocating to the Bay Area for the summer.

Dates for Sublease: ***Mid-May to August, 2026*** (Can also start in June)

The apartment is located in ***Oasis on the Row:***
* Well-lit and clean room (comes furnished and has Air Conditioning)
* Private bathroom
* In-unit washing machine and dryer
* Modern, shared kitchen space with kitchen tools
* Quick building maintenance service
* 10-minute walk to USC Village for groceries, food places, or pilates/yoga studios
* Security system to enter the building (ButterflyMX)
* Courtyard space with a grill and a fireplace (good for studying and work)
* Tanning area
* A vending machine within the building for urgent needs or midnight snacks.

Price: $1800 per month

I am looking for someone who is a responsible and neat person to make sure they are keeping and leaving the space clean.

text:
Hey everyone! 👋 Sam here (30, **straight male**). I’ve been in LA for 1.5 years and I’m looking to move from my solo spot in Santa Monica into a shared place with one other **male roommate**.

**The Rundown:**
* **Professional:** I work in Tech at Google. I’m reliable with bills and generally very laid back—not a clean freak, but I definitely keep a respectable, mess-free home.
* **Interests:** Originally from South Carolina, so I've got that easygoing energy. I’m an actor, a big sports fan, and love staying active/exploring the city.
* **Living Style:** I'm a "work hard, play hard" type who treats my home as a sanctuary. Looking for a similar vibe where we can grab a beer or watch a game but also respect each other's space.

**Looking For:**
* **Area:** Abbot Kinney or Ocean Park (as close to the beach as possible).
* **Timeline:** Mid-to-late April move-in.
* **Budget:** Aiming for under **$2k**, but I have flexibility for the right spot.

If you have a lead on a room or want to team up to find a new lease, shoot me a DM! ✌️

IG: https://www.instagram.com/sam_brooks_/

text:
## Westwood 1BR near UCLA – bright unit + parking – available late April.

Hi everyone,

I’m relocating out of LA and looking for someone to take over my 1-bedroom apartment in Westwood around **April 22**.

It’s a bright and calm apartment with lots of natural light, in a safe and quiet building. Great location—walking distance to UCLA, Westwood Village, restaurants, and grocery stores.

Rent is **$2450/month**, and only electricity is separate (other utilities are included). The unit comes with assigned parking, and the building has a pool and controlled access.

I also have a furnished option available (bed, sofa, desk, dining table, etc., plus a digital keyboard), which can make it fully move-in ready. I’m planning to sell everything together for around **$1100**, but it’s optional.

The lease runs until **September 5, 2026**, and the process would go through building management.

Ideally looking for someone who can move in around April 22 so the transition is smooth.

Happy to share schedule a visit—feel free to message me!

text: The best permanent makeup expert for you 🫶free consultation 👌

sharedPost.text:
But this is not the final healed result.

Yes — lips can look beautiful immediately after the procedure: brighter, fuller, more saturated.
But this is not the final healed result.

Right after lip blush, some swelling is completely normal, and the color always appears more intense at first.
The swelling usually goes down within 24 hours. Starting around day 2, the lips begin to peel, and within the next few days the color becomes noticeably softer.

Once healed, the result looks much more natural, softer, and more balanced.
So whether your first thought is “I love how bright this looks” or “this feels too bold for me,” healing changes the appearance completely.

That’s why fresh results should never be judged as the final outcome.

If you have a question DM @olesia.sharun.pmu

PRIVATE BEDROOM & PRIVATE BATHROOM NEAR USC Village (Female Subleaser Only)
I am looking for a female student to sublease my room in my LA apartment close to the USC campus, as I am relocating to the Bay Area for the summer.

**Dates for Sublease: **Preferably Mid-May to August, 2026 (Can also start in June)

The apartment is located in*** Oasis on the Row:***
* Well-lit and clean room (comes furnished and has Air Conditioning)
* Private bathroom
* In-unit washing machine and dryer
* Modern, shared kitchen space with kitchen tools
* Quick building maintenance service
* 10-minute walk to USC Village for groceries, food places, or pilates/yoga studios
* Security system to enter the building (ButterflyMX)
* Courtyard space with a grill and a fireplace (good for studying and work)
* Tanning area
* A vending machine within the building for urgent needs or midnight snacks.

Price: $1800 per month

I am looking for someone responsible and neat to make sure they are keeping and leaving the space clean.

# **Two Blocks North of Campus! **
## **RECENTLY REMODELED, SPACIOUS 3-BEDROOM APARTMENTS IN PRIME LOCATION, TWO BLOCKS NORTH OF USC CAMPUS: PERFECT FOR STUDENTS! YOUR IDEAL OFF-CAMPUS SPOT AWAITS! STONE ON 30TH IS A USC ALUMNI-OWNED PROPERTY. **

Available starting May and August, perfect for students in the class of 2027, 2028, 2029. Each room is private, comes with a queen bed, desk, chair, dining table/island with four high-top dining chairs, and includes a walk-in closet. 

A female student is seeking two female roommates, and a male is seeking two male or female roommates, to each share a spacious three-bedroom apartment. Generously sized rooms and a comfortable layout make this an ideal living arrangement for students looking for space, privacy, and a welcoming home environment.

Coming available Fall 2026/2027: two 3-bedroom apartments, 1 four-bedroom apartment, two 1-bedroom houses, and one has an office. 

Apartment Highlights:
* ***Recently remodeled interiors***** with high ceilings and large windows**
* **Spacious bedrooms and large living rooms, and large kitchens.**
* **Updated kitchens, with custom slow-close cabinets, updated appliances, and plenty of counter space**
* **Updated bathrooms**

**Location Perks:**
* **Just two blocks north of campus and 1.5 blocks from University Village and around the corner from The Row.**
* **A half a block to the new Rawlinson Stadium **
* **In the DPS/CSC protected area with free Lyft access**

**Community Features:**
* **Private security gated property, with a quiet courtyard and gas barbecue **
* **Dual entrances (front and side) and security cameras for added peace of mind**

**Contact Us!**

**Texting and calling are the preferred and fastest forms of communication.**

**If you're interested, have any questions, or would like to set up a tour, please visit our website and call or text us:**

[https://www.studentlivingsc.com/](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/)

**Call: (424) 436 - 5967**

text:
Room for rent in 5bed/2bath house near USC

-   available April 15th for a 4 1/2 month lease until August 31st, 2026 (renewable for a year after that)

-   the room rents for $1,150  per month
-   the deposit is one month's rent
-   the house has 5 bedrooms and 2 shared bathrooms

-   the rooms are all single

-   utilities, parking, weekly housekeeping and weekly gardening are all included in
    rent
-  no pets are allowed

-  1454 w 36th, Los Angeles CA 90018

There's a very laid back vibe at the house, your housemates would be:

**Jocque**

My name is Jocque,  I'm 23 years old, I was born and raised in Los Angeles, CA, and graduated from UCSC with a double major in Film and Game Design. I'm a clean, respectful, and easygoing person who values open communication and shared responsibility. I enjoy climbing and exploring the outdoors whenever I get the chance. I enjoy playing video games, reading, writing, and filmmaking. I'm currently not in school at the moment, but I do plan on pursuing a master's degree either in Game design or film.

**Yash**

I'm 23, I'm from MD but graduated from Berkeley last year and I'm starting a PhD in math at USC this year (hoping to find long-term housing since I'll be here for a few years). Besides studying, I play a few instruments and write music, and go out often to concerts, movies, things like that.

I'd say about a 7-8, I don't make much of a mess and I'm usually either out of the house or keeping to myself in my room and studying or writing, but I don't mind if other people aren't super clean as long as its not obtrusive (i.e. I don't mind if people accidentally leave out books or clothes, but dirty dishes cluttering the sink, clothes left too long in the washer/dryer, spills etc I'd rather not deal with).

**Luke** 

"My name is Luke, I'm 22, I'm from Tracy, California, and I graduated from UCSD with a BS in Business Psychology and a minor in Entrepreneurship & Innovation. Before college, I lived in Tracy, CA, where I produced and directed some silly short films and YouTube videos. I currently work remotely as a part-time startup co-founder in the BPO industry and as a reader for UC Berkeley. On the weekends, I PA for film projects in LA, which is why I am moving here from San Diego. My long-term goal is to become a movie director, and I'm applying to MFA programs (I'm writing a short film with my current housemate). In my free time, I enjoy watching movies, gaming, reading, and playing guitar. I love all types of music, especially pop-punk and metal. I also occasionally go line dancing and raving."

**Clifford**

My name is Clifford, I’m from San Antonio, Texas and I’m in the United States Army Reserve, a musical theater composer/Live Sound Audio Engineer, a supervisor at a local restaurant as well as a private piano instructor. I’ve spent most of my life around the world, being a child of a military family. After joining the military, I was stationed in Korea, and Europe for most of my career, so it’s given me the opportunity to see the world and meet all different kinds of people and cultures. You can drop a pin somewhere in Europe and I’ve probably been there. 

If I’m not working I’m spending most of my days, practicing working on my craft, or hiking, even line dancing at a local bar I frequent. I’m quiet for the most part when not practicing and very clean. I’ve got my associates in Music Production and am currently going to LA FILM for my bachelors in Audio Engineering, with the intentions of eventually getting my masters. I love learning. I also love and enjoy a sense of community. So I’m definitely a people person for sure. 

1-10 cleanliness, I would an 8 only because ever so often I build set pieces and costumes, so in my personal space, you might see bits and pieces of a build happening. 

------

Everybody is in their early to mid twenties, and rooms usually go quickly when they become available.

- Utilities and Parking are included in rent

- Weekly Housekeeping and Gardening ( the housekeepers clean the common areas, kitchen and bathrooms)

- On site laundry facilities

- Individual AC/heater in every room

- High speed wireless internet throughout the house

- Awesome yard with lots of plants and a BBQ

- stacked parking for 5 cars in the driveway

- Music studio in the back (not part of rent)

- Cool, laid back roommates

- Students and recent graduates transitioning to the working world welcome!

- Young film makers have used the house as a location on several occasions.

For rental applications please contact Jan Pauck

sharedPost.text:
“I don’t want it to look like a tattoo.”

I hear this sentence more than any other.

And honestly? I completely understand.

Most people imagine the same thing: harsh lines, solid fill, something that sits on top of the skin and screams “I have permanent makeup.”

That’s not what my clients want.
And that’s not what you’re looking at here.

These photos show exactly why.

On the left: the before — no makeup, natural features.
On the right: the healed result.

Not fresh. Not swollen. Not dark.
Healed.

Here’s what so many people don’t realize until they see it:

When permanent makeup heals correctly — with the right technique, right depth, right pigment — it doesn’t look like a tattoo.

It settles into the skin.
It becomes soft.
It blends with your natural features instead of competing with them.

There are no harsh edges.
No artificial outline.
Just refinement.

My work is built on one principle:
Enhance, don’t cover.

I’m not here to draw something new on your face.
I’m here to restore what faded, balance what shifted, and give you consistency without the daily effort.

So when it heals?
You don’t see “makeup.”
You don’t see “tattoo.”
You just see you — polished.

If you’ve been considering permanent makeup but were afraid it would look too harsh or obvious — save this post.

This is your proof that “healed” and “tattoo-like” are not the same thing.

👇 Not sure if this style is right for you?
DM me @olesia.sharun.pmu the word “NATURAL” and I’ll help you understand what to expect.

# **Two Blocks North of Campus! **
## **RECENTLY REMODELED, SPACIOUS 3-BEDROOM APARTMENTS IN PRIME LOCATION, TWO BLOCKS NORTH OF USC CAMPUS: PERFECT FOR STUDENTS! YOUR IDEAL OFF-CAMPUS SPOT AWAITS! STONE ON 30TH IS A USC ALUMNI-OWNED PROPERTY. **

Available starting May and August, perfect for students in the class of 2027, 2028, 2029. Each room is private, comes with a queen bed, desk, chair, dining table/island with four high-top dining chairs, and includes a walk-in closet. 

A female student is seeking two female roommates, and a male is seeking two male or female roommates, to each share a spacious three-bedroom apartment. Generously sized rooms and a comfortable layout make this an ideal living arrangement for students looking for space, privacy, and a welcoming home environment.

Coming available Fall 2026/2027: two 3-bedroom apartments, 1 four-bedroom apartment, two 1-bedroom houses, and one has an office. 

Apartment Highlights:
* ***Recently remodeled interiors***** with high ceilings and large windows**
* **Spacious bedrooms and large living rooms, and large kitchens.**
* **Updated kitchens, with custom slow-close cabinets, updated appliances, and plenty of counter space**
* **Updated bathrooms**

**Location Perks:**
* **Just two blocks north of campus and 1.5 blocks from University Village and around the corner from The Row.**
* **A half a block to the new Rawlinson Stadium **
* **In the DPS/CSC protected area with free Lyft access**

**Community Features:**
* **Private security gated property, with a quiet courtyard and gas barbecue **
* **Dual entrances (front and side) and security cameras for added peace of mind**

**Contact Us!**

**Texting and calling are the preferred and fastest forms of communication.**

**If you're interested, have any questions, or would like to set up a tour, please visit our website and call or text us:**

[[https://www.studentlivingsc.com/](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/)](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/) 

**Email: **astone18@me.com

**Call: (424) 436 - 5967**

206 Oliver St.
Turn of the Century Charm
206 Oliver St. Near the River, West Columbia, SC
Old Home Charm, Awesome History, Awesome Location
$2,000 

READY AUG 5th for Move-In

One Block from the Congaree Riverwalk
2BR 1bath with office/studio/study - Washer & Dryer Included

Turn of the Century Appeal. Gardeners Delight - Built in 1908 in the historic Brookland Mill Village of West Columbia, 206 Oliver is a charming mill house a block from the West Columbia Riverwalk on the Congaree River and Carraway Park! This mill house was built to house workers at the first electrified mill in the United States (now the State Museum)

Urban farming/gardening at its best! There are apple, pear, orange, peach, and fig trees in the back garden, and plenty of room to grow vegetables, herbs, and plant flowers! It is in a historical district surrounded by old hardwood trees and quaint houses. Fantastic southern front porch, back deck, large fenced-in yard with a tool shed, compost area, raised garden beds, and numerous fruit trees. Lawn maintained by owner.

Located one mile from the Statehouse and the University of South Carolina campus. Short distance to Five Points, Soda City Market on Main, Bull Street Extension Development, The Vista, and 1 block from the arts and festivals found on Meeting St. & State St., this is a gem of a location.. This home has the charming features of a turn-of-the-century home but has been renovated with new windows, HVAC (new 15 seer HVAC systems for better efficiency), kitchen appliances, a tiled bathroom, and new roofing and siding.

Getting evicted because you can't pay the $1,200 a month to rent  a room? Need some time to get it together? Call Anchor Haven!

3. Working and living in your car because you can't afford  an apartment? Call Anchor Haven!
4. Working and your mom kicking you out? Call Anchor Haven!
5. Tired of paying high rent living with 5 other people in the house? Call Anchor Haven!

7. Terrible credit score, call Anchor Haven!
8. Need a place that will allow you to save some money and get your credit score right? Call Anchor Haven!
9. Got a dog, can't find a place? Call Anchor Haven!

Anchor Haven is a Los Angeles–based mobile transitional housing provider offering professionally managed emergency and short-term MOBILE housing solutions for low-income families and individuals experiencing housing instability.

Our mobile camper units are inexpensive, (allows you to save money), clean, professionally managed and designed to offer safety, stability, and comfort during your transition toward permanent placement in an apartment or a house.

📍 Now Available – 4  Beds for Rent $350 per month | Shared unit with stove etc. | $650 rent the whole unit!

✅ What We Provide:
Your monthly rent includes:
* 24 hour Security monitoring on both units 
*Small refrigerator 
*Microwave
*Water
 *Propane (for heat and cooking)
*1000W Power Bank for electricity
*3600 watt  Gas Generator (for additional power)
*WiFi 
*E-scooter (20 MPG) to rent for transportation – courtesy of Anchor.

We are committed to maintaining a respectful, clean, quite and supportive living environment for all residents.

📞 Contact Information
If you or someone you know is in need of emergency transitional housing in the Los Angeles area, have them reach out to us to inquire about availability and next steps. 

No credit check , no background check, no deposit!

Thank you and God bless you on your journey towards permanent housing.

Tracy Jackson
Manager 
323-835-9301

text:
Luxury Student Housing – Steps from USC Gate 6

Available Spring 2026 and for the Fall 2026–2027 academic years

Live in style less than a block from USC’s Gate 6 entrance. This modern 4-plex student housing community offers the ultimate blend of comfort, convenience, and design. Each unit features six spacious bedrooms and five full bathrooms, fully furnished with contemporary décor. Kitchens are equipped with stainless steel appliances, and every unit includes an in-unit washer and dryer for hassle-free living.

Rising four stories high, the residences offer open layouts, abundant natural light, and private rooftop decks with sweeping views of Los Angeles. Limited parking is available for an additional fee.

The property is located within USC’s Department of Public Safety (DPS) patrol zone and is further secured with private security cameras throughout the premises, giving students and parents added peace of mind.

Exclusively for USC students, this property provides an unbeatable location and an ideal setup for groups of friends looking to live together just steps from campus.

Leasing now for Spring 2026 and Fall 2025–2027. Schedule a walkthrough today — private tours are now being offered.

Hathaway Recovery Center Review (2026): A Complete Guide to Treatment, Cost, and Results.

Addiction affects every part of life—health, relationships, career, and emotional well-being. When you begin searching for addiction treatment centers, choosing the right facility becomes one of the most important decisions you’ll make.

This 2026 review of Hathaway Recovery Center provides a clear, SEO-optimized breakdown of what to expect, who it’s best for, and whether it delivers real value for recovery.

What Is Hathaway Recovery Center?
Hathaway Recovery Center is a private addiction treatment facility in Claremont, California, offering structured, medically supervised care in a calm, high-end environment.

The center focuses on treating addiction as a medical and psychological condition, not a personal failure. Its programs combine clinical care, therapy, and mental health support to address both substance use and underlying issues.

Key Features
Physician-led detox with 24/7 monitoring
Evidence-based therapies (CBT and more)
Dual diagnosis treatment (mental health + addiction)
Medication management and psychiatric care
Private, structured recovery setting
Hathaway positions itself as a premium rehab center, emphasizing safety, privacy, and individualized care.

Who Should Consider Hathaway Recovery Center?
Not every rehab program fits every person. Hathaway is especially suited for individuals who need structured, medically guided recovery.

Best Fit Clients
Individuals needing medical detox and supervision
Clients with co-occurring mental health conditions
Professionals seeking privacy and discretion
People who have relapsed after outpatient programs
Those wanting continuous, step-by-step care
If you fall into one of these groups, Hathaway may offer a stronger foundation for long-term recovery.

Hathaway Recovery Center Services: In-Depth Review
Quality of Care and Clinical Approach
The quality of treatment is one of the most important factors when choosing a rehab center.

Hathaway stands out for its structured and medically driven approach, which includes:

24/7 physician-supervised detox
Individual and group therapy sessions
Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
Integrated psychiatric treatment
Low staff-to-client ratios for personalized care
This structure may feel strict to some, but it often leads to more consistent outcomes and accountability.

Post-Treatment Support and Relapse Prevention
Recovery doesn’t end after detox or residential treatment. Long-term success depends heavily on continued support.

Hathaway provides a range of aftercare and relapse prevention services, including:

Outpatient program referrals
Family education and involvement
Personalized relapse prevention plans
Sober living placement assistance
Clients also build peer support connections, which are critical for maintaining sobriety after leaving treatment.

Does My Insurance Cover Addiction Treatment?
The Affordable Care Act (ACA) mandates that health insurance plans must provide coverage for mental health and substance use disorder services. Because addiction is classified as a chronic health condition, you are likely entitled to significant coverage.

However, “coverage” varies based on your specific plan, your medical necessity, and your geographic location.

Commonly covered services at Hathaway Recovery include:

Medication-Assisted Treatment: Professional oversight and management.

Cost and Value for Money

Inpatient Supervised Detox: Ensuring safety during the initial stages of withdrawal.

Acute Residential Treatment: Our private and comfortable, immersive recovery environment.

Partial Hospitalization & Intensive Outpatient Programs: Structured support as you transition back to daily life.

Co-Occurring Disorder Treatment: Integrated care for anxiety, depression, and trauma.

Hathaway Recovery Center is considered a luxury rehab facility, and pricing reflects that positioning.

While it may not be the most affordable option, the value comes from:

Access to experienced medical professionals
Comprehensive dual diagnosis treatment
Seamless transition between levels of care
Comfortable, private accommodations
For individuals prioritizing quality, privacy, and medical oversight, the cost can be justified. However, those seeking budget-friendly options may need to explore alternative centers.

Hathaway Recovery Center Pros and Cons
Advantages
High-quality medical supervision
Strong focus on mental health + addiction
Private and structured environment
Personalized care plans
Considerations
Higher cost compared to standard rehab centers
Less flexibility due to structured programs
Hathaway Recovery Center Location and Environment
Hathaway Recovery is located in Claremont, California, offering a peaceful and controlled setting designed for healing.

What Makes the Environment Different?
Quiet, non-crowded facility
Focus on safety and structure
Comfortable, upscale accommodations
Distraction-free recovery space
This type of environment is ideal for individuals who need focus, stability, and privacy during treatment.

Is Hathaway Recovery Center Worth It?
Choosing a rehab center is a deeply personal decision. Hathaway Recovery Center may be worth it if you:

Want medically supervised detox and treatment
Value privacy and a calm environment
Need support for both addiction and mental health
Prefer a structured, high-accountability program
For many clients, the combination of clinical care and a supportive environment creates a strong foundation for long-term sobriety.

Start Your Recovery Journey Today
Recovery doesn’t have to wait. Whether it’s the start of a new year or simply the moment you decide to change, taking action now can make all the difference.

Hathaway Recovery Center offers:

Detox, residential, and ongoing care
Personalized treatment plans
Insurance verification support
Immediate admissions assistance
📞 Call (909) 971-3333 today to speak with a specialist and begin your recovery journey.

You don’t have to do this alone—help is available, and healing is possible.

text:
# **Two Blocks North of Campus! **
## **RECENTLY REMODELED, SPACIOUS 3-BEDROOM APARTMENTS IN PRIME LOCATION, TWO BLOCKS NORTH OF USC CAMPUS: PERFECT FOR STUDENTS! YOUR IDEAL OFF-CAMPUS SPOT AWAITS! STONE ON 30TH IS A USC ALUMNI-OWNED PROPERTY. **

Available starting May and August, perfect for students in the class of 2027, 2028, 2029. Each room is private, comes with a queen bed, desk, chair, dining table/island with four high-top dining chairs, and includes a walk-in closet. 

A female student is seeking two female roommates, and a male is seeking two male or female roommates, to each share a spacious three-bedroom apartment. Generously sized rooms and a comfortable layout make this an ideal living arrangement for students looking for space, privacy, and a welcoming home environment.

Coming available Fall 2026/2027: two 3-bedroom apartments, 1 four-bedroom apartment, two 1-bedroom houses, and one has an office. 

Apartment Highlights:
* ***Recently remodeled interiors***** with high ceilings and large windows**
* **Spacious bedrooms and large living rooms, and large kitchens.**
* **Updated kitchens, with custom slow-close cabinets, updated appliances, and plenty of counter space**
* **Updated bathrooms**

**Location Perks:**
* **Just two blocks north of campus and 1.5 blocks from University Village and around the corner from The Row.**
* **A half a block to the new Rawlinson Stadium **
* **In the DPS/CSC protected area with free Lyft access**

**Community Features:**
* **Private security gated property, with a quiet courtyard and gas barbecue **
* **Dual entrances (front and side) and security cameras for added peace of mind**

**Contact Us!**

**Texting and calling are the preferred and fastest forms of communication.**

**If you're interested, have any questions, or would like to set up a tour, please visit our website and call or text us:**

[[https://www.studentlivingsc.com/](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/)](https://www.studentlivingsc.com/) 

**Email: **astone18@me.com

**Call: (424) 436 - 5967**

🔑 Entire Apartment for Rent – $2,080/mo |  Jefferson Park | Available April 19
This is a fully standalone unit — your own address, your own front door, your own everything.

**About the unit:**

This is not a room in someone's house. This is a completely self-contained 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment at 2034 W 31st St — its own separate unit with its own private entrance

🏠 Entire private apartment — fully self-contained

🛏️ 1 bedroom / 1 bathroom

📍 West Adams / Jefferson Park — 10 min to DTLA

**What makes this different:**

In-unit laundry at this price point in LA is genuinely rare — most 1BDs at $2,080 have shared laundry or nothing. Brand new appliances, your own dedicated parking spot, and an EV charger in the backlot.

Sitting right between the 10 and 110 freeways — Downtown LA is 10–15 min, Culver City and the Westside under 15 min, Santa Monica about 20 min on the 10, LAX 15–20 min South. Someone employed or in school, respectful, and clean.

Security deposit is one month's rent ($2,080). Income requirement is 3x rent ($6,240/mo gross). Proof via pay stubs or bank statements. Pets considered case by case with a meet and greet. Flexible lease terms available — 12-month, 6-month, or month-to-month at different rates.

**Available April 19. DM me to receive the form. Serious inquiries only.**

2 Beds 2 Baths - Room only

Looking for a Rommate

Hi y’all! We’re looking for a roommate to join me and my girlfriend in our 2 bed / 2 bath apartment in the heart of Hollywood. The apartment is spacious, modern, and has a great open layout with lots of natural light. You’d have your own bedroom (fully furnished) and bathroom, plus access to a fully equipped kitchen and comfortable living space.

The building (Hawthorn Regency) has great amenities including a fitness center, lounge with free coffee/ hot chocolate, business center, and on site security. We are in a great location — walkable to restaurants, bars, shopping, and close to transit. 

We are working professional in the entertainment/production industry. I keep a busy schedule and travel for projects, so the apartment is generally calm and well-maintained. I’m respectful, organized, and value a clean, comfortable home environment.

I’m easygoing, communicative, and appreciate living with someone who is responsible and considerate. I take pride in keeping the space tidy and peaceful.

We do have two cats who mostly stay in my room — they’re friendly, low-key, and well cared for.

 • Rent: $1,550/month

 • Security Deposit: $1,200

 • Utilities: Shared evenly (electricity, internet)

 • Move-in: March

 • Lease Term: 3-month commitment to start, with option to extend to 6 months

Private Bedroom in EaHo/Silver Lake!
Hey everyone! We’re looking for a new roommate to join our 3-bedroom spot right on Melrose. The apartment is 3 blocks from Hollywood, 10 mins to DTLA, and super close to the Metro. You’ll have a private bedroom that can come furnished with a bed/frame or be totally empty for your own setup. You’d be sharing the place with two guys. We keep a calm, tidy, pet-free, and smoke-free home. I’m big on seasonal decorating and the occasional group dinner, so we’re looking for someone who is friendly but also appreciates a peaceful home base.

Details:

• Rent: $1,150 (it includes all the utilities).

• Lease: 6-month minimum sublease (we like keeping things flexible).

• Security: Fully refundable deposit.

We’re looking for:

• Someone with a steady job/income, or financial aid letters are totally fine for students! Good credit, and a respectful, clean lifestyle.

If this sounds like a good fit, shoot me a DM! Tell me a little bit about yourself, what you do for work/fun, and what your typical schedule looks like.

text:
Roommate Wanted – 4BD/4.5BA Townhome in Mid-City (July 1 Move-In)

Hi ladies! 💛

We’re looking for a roommate to fill the 4th bedroom in our beautiful 4bd/4.5ba Mid-City townhome. Our current roommate will not be renewing at the end of our lease (June 30), and we’re hoping to find someone to join us starting July 1st for a 1-year commitment .

✨ The Space:
Private bedroom with en-suite bathroom (shower/tub)
Walk-in closet in every room
Open-concept kitchen with lots of cabinet space
Spacious shared living area + half-bath on main floor
Balcony for fresh air and chill time

💸 Rent & Utilities:
Rent (includes parking): $1150/month
LADWP (fixed plan): ~ $95month per person
WiFi (Spectrum): ~$18/month per person
SoCal Gas ~ $8/month per person 
Parking: includes 1 tandem spot (garage + tandem setup, total of 4 spots)

🏡 About Us: We are all women of color and would love to welcome another POC woman into our home🤎

Kiara – (26) is a part time retail associate and full-time film student. She spends most of her time working on indie films and coordinating film events via @filmsforsundays. She enjoys wine nights, thrifting, and trying new places to eat (especially in ktown).

Semoné – (30) is a full time worker and Clinical psychology graduate student. She enjoys trying new restaurants & cafes, karaoke, going on long walks/hikes, and thrifting. 

Sìmone (29) – I work as a server at a hotel restaurant in West Hollywood and am also an actress, dancer, and journalist. I love hot yoga, hiking, movies, and trying new restaurants/coffee shops with friends.

We all have different schedules and do our own thing day-to-day, but we enjoy occasional roomie nights / girls nights when we can ✨

📍 Location Perks: Centrally located in Mid-City with easy access to:
Koreatown
Culver City
DTLA
Beverly Hills
West Hollywood
Not far from LAX + the beach 🌊

🐾 Pets: We don’t currently have pets, but we’re open to discussing if you have a small furry friend!

We’ve truly loved living here for the last year and are excited to find someone who’s a great fit for our home and energy 💫

If you’re interested, send us a message with a little about yourself and if you’re a good fit, we can schedule a showing of the apartment! 

Semone Watson
